Hassle back potatoes with creamy Cajun chicken and airfried brocollini . Easy, healthy comfort meal  Potato recipe 6 medium potatoes 3 tbsp butter (melted) 2 tbsp olive oil 4–5 cloves garlic (minced) 1½ tsp paprika 1½ tsp onion granules 1½ tsp garlic granules 1 tsp dried parsley Salt & pepper 1–2 tsp all-purpose seasoning Method: Slice each potato thinly (don’t cut all the way through). Mix melted butter, olive oil, garlic, and all seasonings. Brush generously over all 6 potatoes, getting into the layers. Air fry at 180°C for 35–45 mins (depending on size). Brush with extra butter halfway through for that crispy finish. Chicken recipe  Ingredients: 1 tbsp olive oil 1½ tsp Cajun seasoning ½ tsp salt ½ tsp black pepper 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp onion powder Method: Add the sliced chicken to a bowl. Drizzle over the olive oil. Sprinkle all the seasonings evenly. Mix well until every piece is fully coated. Let it sit for 10–15 minutes (optional, but boosts flavor). Pan-fry on medium-high heat until golden and cooked through. Cajun Sauce: 1 tbsp butter ½ onion (diced) 150–200ml heavy cream Same seasonings as chicken Instructions  In the same pan, melt butter and cook onions until soft. Add cream + seasoning, simmer until thickened. Add chicken back in and coat in sauce. #dinnerideas #recipe #easyrecipes #cooking #airfryerrecipe

Had to turn my viral baked lasagne jacket into a tray bake for four … because one potato simply isn’t enough when comfort food calls 🥔😂 This is a take on my baked lasagne style jacket potato just bigger, better, and perfect for feeding four instead of one. Fluffy crispy jackets. Rich leftover Bolognese. Creamy cheesy béchamel. Finished with a golden cheese melt. Would you share this… or keep the whole tray to yourself? 👀 🥔 Lasagne-Style Jacket Potato Tray Bake Serves 4 Ingredients Jackets • 4 large baking potatoes • Olive oil spray • Sea salt & black pepper • 40g butter Filling • 600–700g leftover Bolognese sauce Cheesy Béchamel Sauce • 40g butter • 40g plain flour • 500ml semi-skimmed milk • Black pepper • 100g mixed grated cheese • 30–40g grated Parmesan For layering • 150–200g mozzarella or mixed cheese • Extra Parmesan for topping Method 1. Cook the jacket potatoes Pierce potatoes, rub with olive oil and salt. Air fry at 180°C for 45 minutes, then another 10 minutes until crispy. Oven option: 200°C for about 1 hour until fluffy inside and crunchy outside. 2. Make the cheesy béchamel Melt butter in a pan over medium heat. Stir in flour and cook for 1 minute. Gradually whisk in the milk until smooth and thickened. Season with black pepper, then stir through mixed cheese and Parmesan until melted and creamy. Set aside. 3. Assemble the tray bake Place all 4 crispy jackets into a large tray. Slice open and gently mash the centres with butter, salt and pepper. 👉 Spoon 1 tablespoon of béchamel into each potato and mix through the fluffy middle. Now layer in this order: • Add the leftover Bolognese • Pour over more béchamel sauce • Sprinkle over mozzarella or mixed cheese • Finish with a generous grating of Parmesan 4. Final melt Bake at 180°C for 10–12 minutes or air fry at 180°C for 4–5 minutes until golden, bubbling and irresistible. #foryoupagе #spud #jacketpotato #jacketpotatoes #lasagna

videos.caption: This is seriously one of the best appetizers I’ve ever made, and easy to throw together! 🤤 roasted tomato burrata dip with garlic bread crostinis!) 🍅🧄 Ripe bursted cherry tomatoes, stir in burrata, and scoop it all up with crispy garlic crostinis. A total flavor bomb… have the recipe ready, people WILL ask for it! 🛒You’ll Need: • cherry tomatoes • Olive oil • Salt, pepper, red pepper flakes • Garlic, parsley, oregano • Burrata • Fresh basil • Parmesan • French baguette • Butter, garlic, salt, parm (for garlic butter) 🧈 How to Make: 	1.	Add grape tomatoes to a baking dish and drizzle generously with olive oil (about halfway up). 	2.	Season with salt, pepper, red pepper flakes, garlic, parsley, and oregano. 	3.	Bake at 425°F for 20-30 mins until tomatoes burst (you can gently smash them halfway if they need some assistance in the ‘bursting’ process). 	4.	While that bakes, slice baguette, spread with garlic butter (butter, garlic, salt, parm), and toast 5–7 mins until golden. 	5.	Once you’re ready to serve, top with parm, fresh basil, and burrata. Tarte 3 Chocolats Sans Cuisson Ingrédients Base biscuitée • 150 g de biscuits au cacao  • 60 g de beurre fondu Ganache au chocolat blanc • 125 g de crème liquide entière • 240 g de chocolat blanc Ganache au chocolat au lait • 125 g de crème liquide entière • 188 g de chocolat au lait Ganache au chocolat noir • 125 g de crème liquide entière • 105 g de chocolat noir Préparation Préparez la base biscuitée Réduisez les biscuits en poudre fine. Ajoutez le beurre fondu et mélangez jusqu'à obtenir une texture de sable humide. Versez le mélange dans un moule à tarte ou un cercle de 20 cm de diamètre. Tassez fermement le fond ainsi que les bords à l'aide du dos d'une cuillère ou d'un verre. Placez au réfrigérateur pendant 30 minutes. Préparez la ganache au chocolat blanc Hachez finement le chocolat blanc et placez-le dans un saladier. Faites chauffer la crème jusqu'à frémissement, puis versez-la sur le chocolat.  mélangez délicatement du centre vers l'extérieur jusqu'à obtenir une ganache parfaitement lisse. Versez la ganache sur la base biscuitée froide. Placez au réfrigérateur pendant 45 minutes à 1 heure, jusqu'à ce que la surface soit suffisamment ferme pour accueillir la couche suivante. Préparez la ganache au chocolat au lait Hachez le chocolat au lait et déposez-le dans un saladier. Portez la crème à frémissement puis versez-la sur le chocolat. Laissez reposer 1 minute puis mélangez jusqu'à obtenir une texture lisse et brillante. Versez délicatement cette ganache sur la couche de chocolat blanc bien prise.  Placez à nouveau au réfrigérateur pendant 45 minutes à 1 heure. Préparez la ganache au chocolat noir Hachez le chocolat noir et placez-le dans un saladier. Faites chauffer la crème jusqu'à frémissement puis versez-la sur le chocolat.  Versez délicatement sur la couche de chocolat au lait. 🇬🇧 No-Bake Triple Chocolate Tart Ingredients Biscuit Base • 150 g cocoa biscuits • 60 g melted butter White Chocolate Ganache • 125 g heavy cream • 240 g white chocolate Milk Chocolate Ganache • 125 g heavy cream • 188 g milk chocolate Dark Chocolate Ganache • 125 g heavy cream • 105 g dark chocolate Preparation Prepare the Biscuit Base Crush the biscuits into a fine powder. Add the melted butter and mix until you get a texture similar to wet sand. Pour the mixture into a tart pan or a 20 cm pastry ring. Firmly press it onto the base and up the sides using the back of a spoon or a glass. Place in the refrigerator for 30 minutes. Prepare the White Chocolate Ganache Finely chop the white chocolate and place it in a bowl. Heat the cream until it begins to simmer, then pour it over the chocolate. Mix gently from the center outward until the ganache is perfectly smooth. Pour the ganache over the chilled biscuit base. Place in the refrigerator for 45 minutes to 1 hour, until the surface is firm enough to support the next layer. Prepare the Milk Chocolate Ganache Finely chop the milk chocolate and place it in a bowl. Bring the cream to a simmer, then pour it over the chocolate. Let it sit for 1 minute, then stir until smooth and glossy. Carefully pour this ganache over the set white chocolate layer. Return to the refrigerator for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Prepare the Dark Chocolate Ganache Finely chop the dark chocolate and place it in a bowl. Heat the cream until it begins to simmer, then pour it over the chocolate. Carefully pour the ganache over the milk chocolate layer.

Garlic Parmesan chicken pasta ✨ Ingredients  Chicken  - 1.5 lbs chicken breast, cut in half - 1 tsp roasted garlic powder  - 1 tsp smoked paprika  - 1 tsp oregano  - 1 tsp Italian seasoning  - 1 tsp garlic and herb seasoning  - Salt to taste - 1 tbsp avocado oil (for cooking) - 1 tbsp unsalted butter (for cooking) Sauce + pasta - 14 oz fettuccine pasta  - 1 1/2 cup heavy cream - 6 tbsp unsalted butter - 1/4 cup pasta water - 7 garlic cloves (minced) - 1 shallot (minced) - 1 1/4 cups Parmesan cheese (grated)  - 1 tbsp freshly chopped parsley  - 1 1/2 tsp oregano  - 1 1/2 tsp roasted garlic powder - 1 tsp red chili flakes - Salt and pepper to taste  Instructions  - In a large bowl coat chicken breast with about 2 tsp of olive oil, seasonings, salt and mix until evenly coated. Cover and set aside for 30 minutes to marinate. - Heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Add avocado oil and 1 tbsp of butter. - Sear chicken for 5 minutes per side until a golden crust forms. Deglaze pan with a little chicken broth, lower the heat, cover, and simmer until internal temperature reaches 155F. - Remove chicken from pan, cover in foil, and place into oven set warm. Pasta  - Bring a large pot of water to a rolling boil. Salt it heavily. - Cook pasta according to package instructions until al dente. - Reserve at least 1/4 cup pasta water, then drain. Sauce - To the same pan (medium heat) add butter. - Sauté shallot for 1–2 minutes until soft. - Add minced garlic and cook until fragrant (about 30 seconds). - Season with oregano, garlic powder, chili flakes, salt, and black pepper. Mix until well combined and fragrant  -  Pour in heavy cream and mix  - Simmer gently for 3–5 minutes until slightly thickened. - Lower heat and stir in Parmesan  cheese and pasta water. Mix until well combined. Taste and adjust for seasonings. - Add cooked fettuccine and parsley, mixing until well coated. - Stir in an additional ¼ cup Parmesan until fully combined. - Finish with chopped parsley. - Add sliced chicken on top of pasta  - Finish with extra Parmesan, cracked pepper, or chili flakes if desired. • • • #recipes #pasta #dinnerideas #chickenrecipe #foodideas

This One Pan Chicken & Gravy is an easy and delicious 30 minute dinner!  INGREDIENTS  1 lb chicken breasts  Salt, pepper, garlic powder  3 tbsp butter 3 tbsp flour  2 cups chicken broth  1/2 tsp each of salt, pepper, oregano, and thyme  1 tsp each of paprika, onion powder, garlic powder  INSTRUCTIONS  Cut chicken breasts in half lengthwise to make them thinner. Season the chicken with some salt, pepper, and garlic powder (I don’t use exact measurements for this part).  In a skillet over medium high heat melt 3 tbsp of butter. Once the butter has melted add 3 tbsp of flour and stir continuously until well combined. Let cook for a few minutes while still stirring.  Add 2 cups of chicken broth and stir well. Season with salt, pepper, oregano, thyme, paprika, onion powder, and garlic powder. Stir well and when it starts bubbling add the chicken to the skillet.  Make sure the chicken is covered in the gravy, cover with a lid, and turn the heat down to medium low. Let this cook for 12-15 minutes or until the chicken reaches an internal temp of 165 degrees. My chicken was ready in 12 minutes, but they were pretty thin.  Shred the chicken and serve over mashed potatoes! Enjoy! Let me know if you try it out.  #chickenandgravy #easyrecipe #dinner #onepanmeal #chickenrecipes

Chicken Parmesan 🧀🍗 Prep: 10m | Cook: 10m | Serves: 1-2 Ingredients: The Cutlet: 1 large chicken breast (butterflied & pounded even) Rub: 1 tsp garlic powder, ½ tsp black pepper, salt to taste Breading:  1/4 cup flour | 2 beaten eggs | 1 cup Panko + 1 tsp dried parsley Oil for frying Sauce & Cheese: 1.5 cups marinara sauce 1 cup shredded mozzarella Method: 1. Pre-heat Oven to 350F. 2. Prep & Season: Butterfly chicken, pound even, and rub thoroughly with garlic powder, pepper, and salt. 3. Bread: Dredge in flour ➔ submerge in egg ➔ press firmly into parsley-Panko. 4. Fry: Cook in hot oil (or deep fry) for 3–4 mins per side until deep golden (165°F). Move to a wire rack. 5. Melt: Spread marinara on an oven-safe plate, cover with mozzarella, and bake until mozzarella cheese is melted. Broil for last 3-4 minutes until bubbly and browned. 6. Pour-Over: Drop cutlet onto the hot plate and slide the molten cheese and sauce over the top. Serve immediately! #asmr #recipe #cooking #foodtok

Cornflake Hot Honey Chicken Tenders 🍯🍗 Prep Time: 30 mins | Cook Time: 20 mins | Servings: 4 INGREDIENTS Easy Pantry Ranch 1/2 cup mayonnaise 1/3 cup buttermilk 1 tsp dried dill 1/2 tsp garlic powder 1/2 tsp onion powder 1 tsp white vinegar or lemon juice 1/4 tsp kosher salt 1/4 tsp black pepper Chicken and Marinade 1 1/2 lbs chicken tenderloins, patted dry 1 cup buttermilk 1 tbsp hot sauce 1 tsp kosher salt 1 tsp black pepper 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp smoked paprika 3-Step Breading Station 3/4 cup all-purpose flour + 1/2 tsp kosher salt + 1/2 tsp smoked paprika + 1/2 tsp garlic powder + 1/2 tsp onion powder 2 large eggs + 1 tbsp water, beaten 4 cups plain cornflakes, crushed into coarse crumbs 4-6 cups neutral frying oil Garlic Hot Honey Glaze 1/2 cup honey 2 tbsp fresh minced garlic 1-2 tbsp hot sauce 1 tbsp unsalted butter 1 1/2 tsp apple cider vinegar 1/2 tsp red pepper flakes INSTRUCTIONS 1. Whisk together mayo, buttermilk, dried dill, garlic powder, onion powder, vinegar, salt, and pepper. Cover and refrigerate while prepping the chicken. 2. Whisk buttermilk, hot sauce, salt, pepper, garlic powder, and smoked paprika. Toss chicken tenders in marinade, cover, and chill for 30 minutes to 4 hours. 3. Set up three dishes: seasoned flour, beaten egg wash, and coarsely crushed cornflakes. 4. Drain excess marinade from each tender, dredge in flour, dip in egg wash, and press firmly into cornflakes. Rest on a wire rack for 5-10 minutes. 5. Heat 2 inches of oil in a heavy pot to 350°F. Fry tenders in batches of 3-4 for 4-6 minutes, turning halfway, until golden brown and 165°F internal. Drain on a clean wire rack. 6. Melt butter over low heat and sauté minced garlic for 1 minute. Stir in honey, hot sauce, apple cider vinegar, and red pepper flakes, simmering gently for 2-3 minutes. 7. Drizzle warm garlic hot honey over crispy tenders and serve immediately with chilled ranch. #cooking #recipe #asmr #foodtok

videos.caption: Creamy Tuscan Chicken 🍗✨ This creamy Tuscan chicken is packed with juicy seasoned chicken, garlic, spinach, and sweet grape tomatoes in a rich Parmesan cream sauce. It’s perfect served over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice! 😋  🍗 Creamy Tuscan Chicken Ingredients:  Chicken seasoning  * 2 to 3 chicken breasts, sliced in half * Salt & pepper * ½ tsp smoked paprika * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tbsp Italian seasoning * 1 tsp dried parsley * ½ tsp chili flakes (optional) Sauce: * 1 tbsp butter * ½ onion, diced * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 cup grape tomatoes, halved * 2 cups spinach * 1 cup heavy cream * ¼ cup grated Parmesan * Salt & pepper, to taste * Fresh parsley Directions: Season the chicken with all the spices. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a skillet and cook the chicken for 4–5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Remove and set aside. In the same skillet, melt the butter and sauté the onion and garlic until fragrant. Add the tomatoes and cook for 2–3 minutes, then stir in the spinach until wilted. Pour in the heavy cream and Parmesan, stirring until smooth and creamy. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Return the chicken to the skillet and let simmer for 2–3 minutes. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice. Enjoy! 🤍

High Protein Grilled Chicken Alfredo Pasta! Only 595 Calories🍗🍝🧀 One of the most indulgent meal preps i’ve made! Chicken is cooked to perfection, paired with a rich creamy Alfredo Pasta. So simple and easy with great macros🤌🏽 Macros Per Serving (4 Servings Total) 595 Calories | 59g Protein | 50g Carbs | 16g Fat Ingredients (To Make 4 Servings) Grilled Chicken - 800g Cubed Chicken Breast (I get mine from @saffron_alley ) - 1 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 1.5 Tsp Parsley - 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes (remove if you don’t like spicy) - 1.5 Tsp Garlic Powder - 1.5 Tsp Paprika - 2 Tsp Olive Oil - 20g Light Buttet (For cooking + once cooked) Creamy Alfredo Pasta - 210g Uncooked / 520g Cooked Pasta (I chose fettuccine) - 80g Chopped White Onion - 4 Garlic Cloves Chopped - 1 Tsp Salt - 1 Tsp Italian Herbs - 1 Tsp Parsley - 0.5 Tsp Chilli Flakes (remove if you don’t like spicy) - 1 Tsp Paprika - 150g Tomato Sauce / Passata  - 300ml Light Evaporated Milk (Brand: Sainsbury’s) - 130g Light Cream Cheese (Brand: Philadelphia) - 30g Grated Parmesan Cheese - Optional add Pasta Water if the sauce is too thick Don’t forget to check out my Digital Cookbooks with over 200+ Delicious High Protein Recipes👨‍🍳❤️ Important Cooking Notes - Cook the chicken cubes on medium high heat, 3-4 mins then turn them over and cook for another 3 mins - Once cooked, lower the heat, add a little more butter then mix it all in and set aside - Cook the onion for 5-6mins till soft then add the spices. Mix it in for a min before adding the tomato sauce - You want to let this sauce cook for at least 5mins on low heat till it bubbles and separates a little - Add the milk and cream cheese on low heat, then keep stirring till combined and thick - To reheat, place both chicken and pasta in a pan, low heat, cover with a lid for 5 mins. ⇩ Full Recipe 🍗 ⇩ Macros per 1 meal prep: Protein: 40g Carbs: 87g Fat: 8g Calories: 585 Ingredients per 2 servings (makes 2 meal preps): Chicken - 1lb chicken thigh, boneless, skinless, raw - 2 tsp salt - 2 tsp black pepper - 1/4 cup cornstarch - 1/3 second spray oil - 1 tsp sesame seeds -1 green onion Soy Glaze Sauce - 2.5 tbsp soy sauce - 1 tbsp oyster sauce - 2.5 tbsp honey - 1.5 tbsp minced garlic Cucumber Salad - 2 Persian cucumbers - 2 tsp salt - 1.5 tbsp rice vinegar - 2 tsp brown sugar - 1/2 tbsp soy sauce - 1 tsp sesame seeds 1.5 cup cooked rice How to make it yourself: 1. Dice your cucumbers into thin circles. 2. Lay your chicken thighs flat, season with salt and pepper, and coat evenly with cornstarch on both sides 3. In a bowl, mixed together, soy sauce, oyster sauce, honey, and minced garlic to make your sauce. 4. On a pan coated with spray oil on medium heat, cook your chicken until golden brown, crispy on both sides, and cooked through. 5. Remove the cooked chicken from the pan and pour in your sauce to let it simmer for 45 seconds the add back in your chicken and let it coat the sauce for a minute then quickly remove. 6. In a bowl, mix together your sliced cucumbers with salt. Let it sit for 15 minutes until the excess liquid drains from the cucumbers. 7. Remove the excess liquid from the cucumbers and rinse the cucumbers with water. 8. Pat dry the cucumbers and add them into a bowl with rice vinegar, brown sugar, soy sauce, and sesame seeds and mix well to make your salad. 9. In a meal prep container, add 1/2 your steamed rice, 1/2 your cucumber salad, and 1/2 your chicken optionally topped with sesame seeds and sliced green onions. 10. Pro tip: when meal prepping to re-heat, make sure to put your salad & meat into separate ziploc bags to avoid getting the rice soggy. Some will remain after preparing the chicken, flour, buttermilk, and hot oil.) Seasoned Flour 2 cups all-purpose flour 1/2 cup cornstarch 1 tsp baking powder 2 tbsp Nashville hot seasoning Buttermilk Mixture 2 cups buttermilk 2 large eggs 1 tbsp Nashville hot seasoning Nashville Hot Oil 1/2 cup hot frying oil 2 tbsp Nashville hot seasoning Caesar Dressing 1/2 cup mayonnaise 2 tbsp freshly grated Parmesan 1 tbsp lemon juice 1 tsp Dijon mustard 1 tsp Worcestershire sauce 1 small garlic clove, finely grated 1/2 tsp black pepper 1–2 tbsp cold water, as needed Salt, to taste Caesar Salad 1 cup finely chopped romaine 2–3 tbsp Caesar dressing 1–2 tbsp freshly grated Parmesan Assembly 5–6 toasted brioche or rustic buns Dill pickle slices Parmesan cheese Extra Caesar dressing, as needed Instructions Cut chicken into 5–6 sandwich-sized pieces, pound evenly, and season lightly with salt. Throwback to this Honey Garlic Lemon Pepper Chicken Thighs recipe. The full recipe is posted below and can also be found in my cookbook Let’s Get Into It! Check out my cookbook through the link in my bio. Notes: If you are doubling the recipe, do not add more lemon slices to the sauce as it will become too bitter. Ingredients: •4 bone-in Chicken Thighs •2 tsp Lemon Pepper Seasoning •2 tsp Garlic Powder •2 tsp Smoked Paprika •1 tsp Kosher Salt •1 tsp Black Pepper •1 tsp Onion Powder •3 tbsp Olive Oil Sauce •2 tbsp Unsalted Butter •¼ cup Honey •4 slices of Lemon •4 tsp minced garlic •1 tbsp freshly squeezed Lemon Juice •2 tsp Low-Sodium Soy Sauce Instructions: Prepare the Chicken 1. Clean and pat the thighs dry. In a small bowl, combine the lemon pepper seasoning, garlic powder, paprika, salt, black pepper, and onion powder. Stir in the olive oil to make a seasoning paste. Fully coat the thighs with the paste, spreading it underneath the thigh skin to flavor the meat. Transfer the chicken to a zip-top bag or a container with a lid. Let the thighs marinate for at least 2 hours or up to overnight. 2. When the chicken is done marinating, preheat the oven to 425°F (215°C). Line a large baking pan or 9x13-inch (23x33cm) baking pan with foil, set a baking rack in the pan, and coat the baking rack with nonstick cooking spray. 3. Place the thighs on the rack skin side down. Bake, uncovered. for 30 minutes. Turn over the thighs and continue to bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until cooked through. The internal temperature should be at least 165°F (75°C). When cutting into the chicken near the thickest section, all of the juices should run clear. While the chicken is baking we can prepare the sauce. Prepare the Sauce 4. In a large skillet over medium-low heat, melt the butter. When the butter is melted, add the honey, lemon slices, garlic, lemon juice, soy sauce, and 1 tablespoon water. Bring the sauce to a simmer, then cook, periodically stirring the sauce until it thickens, about 5 minutes. 5. When the chicken is done, brush the sauce all over both sides and bake for an additional 5 minutes, until the sauce has browned and turned sticky. Allow the thighs to cool for 3 to 5 minutes, then enjoy! #royaleeats

Here is my One Pot Creamy Chicken Pasta Dinner 🤤🍝 full recipe on my website.  Crispy on the outside, juicy and full of flavor chicken over a rich, creamy, cheesy pasta. Easy comfort food made in one pot! No mess no stress dinner 😊 One Pot Creamy Chicken Pasta:  Ingredients Chicken 2 chicken breasts 1 tbsp olive oil 1–2 tbsp butter 1 tsp Cajun seasoning 1 tsp smoked paprika 1 tsp sweet paprika 1 tsp Italian seasoning 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder Salt and black pepper, to taste Pasta & Sauce 8 oz dry rigatoni 24 oz heavy cream 24 oz chicken broth (add more if needed) 1 tsp Cajun seasoning 1 tsp smoked paprika 1 tsp sweet paprika 1 tsp Italian seasoning 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder 1–2 cups shredded cheese of your choice (I used mozzarella, sharp cheddar, and medium cheddar) Optional Garnish Fresh parsley, chopped Grated Parmesan cheese Red pepper flakes Instructions Season the chicken: Coat the chicken breasts with olive oil, Cajun seasoning, smoked paprika, sweet paprika, Italian seasoning, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper. Let the chicken marinate in the refrigerator for 15–30 minutes for the best flavor. Cook the chicken: Heat a large pot or skillet over medium-high heat and cook the chicken for about 2–3 minutes per side, or until golden brown and fully cooked. Remove the chicken from the pan and let it rest. Cook the pasta: In the same pot, add the rigatoni, heavy cream, chicken broth, 1–2 tbsp butter, and seasonings. Stir everything together, cover, and let the pasta simmer until al dente, stirring occasionally. Add more broth or cream if needed while the pasta cooks. Add the cheese: Once the pasta is cooked, add your shredded cheese and stir until melted and creamy. I used mozzarella, sharp cheddar, and medium cheddar, but feel free to use whatever cheese you have in the fridge. Finish and serve: Slice the rested chicken and place it on top of the creamy pasta. Garnish with fresh parsley, Parmesan cheese, or red pepper flakes if desired. #easyrecipe  #pasta #chicken #familydinner #onepot

Mini Cinnamon Sugar Donuts! Ingredients * 1 tsp yeast * 3 tbsp sugar * 110 ml milk (⅓ cup + 2 tbsp) * 1 egg * 280 g flour (≈ 2¼ cups) * 1 tsp salt * 38 g softened butter (≈ 2 tbsp + 2 tsp) Cinnamon Sugar Coating * 140 g sugar (≈ ⅔ cup) * 1 tsp ground cinnamon Instructions 1. In a bowl, mix the milk, yeast, and sugar. Add the egg, flour, salt, and softened butter all at once, then mix and coil fold the dough several times. Cover and let rest for 20 minutes. Coil fold again, cover, and let rise for 2 hours or until doubled in size. 2. Place your dough onto a work surface and shape it into a long log. Using a knife, cut it into 24 equal pieces. 3. Roll each piece into a ball and place it onto a small square of parchment paper. Gently flatten each one, cover, and let rise for 30 minutes. Uncover and let rest for another 5 minutes before frying. 4. Make sure the oil is hot before frying. Carefully place the donuts into the hot oil, gently remove the parchment paper, and fry until golden on both sides. 5. Mix the sugar and cinnamon together. While the donuts are still warm, coat both sides in the cinnamon sugar. #donuts #donut #bread #breadtok #homemade

30-Minute Garlic Butter Steak Bites & Potatoes 🥩🥔🧄 If you need a quick and easy dinner idea, you have to try these garlic butter steak bites and potatoes! The potatoes are perfectly seasoned and crispy, and the steak is juicy, tender, and tossed in the most delicious garlic butter. And the best part? You can have dinner on the table in about 30 minutes! 🤤 RECIPE BELOW ⬇️  Potatoes: * 4 russet potatoes, diced * 2 tbsp olive oil * 1 tsp each: salt, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika & Italian seasoning * ½ tsp black pepper Steak: * 1½ lbs sirloin tip steak, cubed * 1 tsp olive oil * 1–2 tsp Montreal steak seasoning * 1 tbsp oil for cooking * 2 tbsp butter * 3 cloves garlic, minced * Fresh parsley Instructions 👩🏽‍🍳 1. Wash, peel, and dice your potatoes. Toss with olive oil and seasonings. Salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, and Italian seasoning. Y’all know I don’t measure. I just season until my ancestors tell me to stop! 😂 2. Air fry at 400°F for 20–25 minutes, shaking halfway through, until crispy. You can also bake at 425°F for 25–30 minutes or pan-fry! 3. While those cook, cut your steak into bite-sized pieces and toss with a little olive oil and steak seasoning. I used Montreal, but use your favorite! 4. Get your skillet nice and hot! Add a little oil and sear steak for about 2 minutes per side until browned. Cast iron works best, but any skillet will do! 5. Reduce heat, scoot steak to the edges, and add butter and garlic. Cook for 30–60 seconds until fragrant, then toss everything in that garlic butter. 6. Turn off the heat, add your crispy potatoes, gently mix, and top with fresh parsley! Serve with cheesy rice, mac and cheese, asparagus, or whatever your heart desires! ❤️ Save this for your next easy weeknight dinner! 🔖 #GarlicButterSteakBites #SteakAndPotatoes #30MinuteMeals #EasyDinnerIdeas #WeeknightDinners

Para el día 2, tu piel se siente más suave y tu rostro luce menos cansado. A mitad del reto tu cabello y tus uñas se fortalecen, con menos quiebre y más brillo. En el día 6, las líneas finas se suavizan ligeramente y mejora la textura facial. Al llegar al día 7, tu piel luce más luminosa y tus articulaciones se sienten más ligeras al moverte, dando una sensación general de bienestar. — Lo que verás en este video: * Cambios reales día a día tomando colágeno en ayunas * Beneficios en piel, articulaciones, digestión y energía * Reducción de crujidos y mejora de movilidad * Cómo el colágeno fortalece cabello y uñas * Efectos visibles en firmeza, brillo y textura de la piel * Tip para absorberlo mejor cada mañana Comenta: ¿Te atreves al reto de 7 días? Creamy Cajun Chicken Pasta 🔥 One-pot & ready in under 20 minutes… juicy cajun chicken served with the creamiest garlic parmesan sauce 🤤 If there is one piece of cookware you need in your kitchen, it’s gotta be the @Made In Cookware Saucier!  I’ve been using Made In for a long time and the Saucier is my favorite piece to cook with… it can do everything your sauce pan can do, but better!  If you’re looking to upgrade your cookware, I linked my favorite Made In pieces in my bio. For the Chicken:  -2 large chicken breasts, flattened  -Seasoning: 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp Italian seasoning, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper, 1–2 tsp cayenne pepper (optional)  -1 tbsp olive oil For the Pasta & Sauce:  -8 oz (225 g) rigatoni  -3 tbsp butter  -1 large shallot, finely diced  -6–8 garlic cloves, minced  -1 cup heavy cream, room temperature  -Seasoning: 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp Italian seasoning, 1 tsp black pepper  -3/4 cup freshly grated Parmesan (please use fresh!)  -1/2 cup pasta water, as needed (aka liquid gold) Instructions: 1. Pat the chicken dry & pound to an even thickness. Coat with 1 tbsp olive oil, then season on both sides. 2. Boil the pasta in salted water until just shy of al dente. Save at least 1/2 cup pasta water before draining (‼️). Set pasta aside. 3. Heat a large pan or pot over medium heat for a few mins. Add 2 tbsp olive oil, increase to medium-high, add the chicken. Sear for 3–4 mins per side until golden, then reduce heat if needed and cook through. Set aside to rest. 4. Reduce heat to medium. In the same pan, melt the butter, scraping up all that fond. Add the shallot & cook for 5 mins, add the garlic, cook for 1 more min. 5. Reduce heat to medium-low, slowly pour in the cream. Add the seasonings & simmer for 2–3 mins. Reduce heat to low, add the parmesan & stir until smooth. 6. Add the pasta & 1/4 cup pasta water, toss over low heat for 1–2 mins until the sauce is silky. Add more pasta water as needed. Slice the chicken, add it on top, and finish with more parm and fresh parsley!  #easydinner #pasta #recipe #cookingathometiktoktv

One-Pan Chicken Shawarma Rice Bowls 🔥 All the shawarma flavor, none of the extra steps… juicy spiced chicken, onion rice pilaf, refreshing salad and a creamy garlic sauce 🤌 For the Chicken: -1.5 lbs (680g) boneless, skinless chicken thighs -Seasoning: 1 tbsp paprika, 1 tbsp cumin, 1 tbsp onion powder, 2 tsp coriander, 1 tsp allspice, 2 tsp turmeric, 2 tsp pepper, 1 tsp salt -3 tbsp olive oil + 8 garlic cloves -½ lemon, juiced -2 tsp bouillon (I used the roasted chicken base from @Better Than Bouillon) For the Rice: -3 tbsp butter + 1 ½ cups yellow onion, diced -1 tbsp turmeric, 2 tsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp pepper -1 ½ cups basmati rice -3 cups hot water  -3 tsp bouillon  For the Fresh Sumac Salad: -½ large red onion, thinly sliced -1 cup cherry tomatoes, quartered -1 cup cucumber, sliced then halved -1 tsp salt, 1 tsp black pepper & 2 tsp sumac -½ lemon, juiced For the Garlic Sauce: -¼ cup mayonnaise + ¼ cup plain Greek yogurt -2 to 3 garlic cloves + 1 tbsp fresh parsley -1 tsp salt + 1 tsp black pepper -½ lemon, juiced + 1 tbsp olive oil 1. In a bowl, combine the chicken with the spices, olive oil, garlic, lemon juice and bouillon. Mix well. Marinate for as long as your patience can handle. 2. Heat a large pan over medium-high heat and add a drizzle of olive oil. Once hot, add the chicken in batches. Cook for 6 to 8 mins per side until golden and cooked through. Set aside. 3. Reduce heat to medium-low. Add butter to the same pan then the onions & cook, stirring often, until translucent. Add the garlic & spices, cook for 1 to 2 mins. Add the rice and toast for 2 mins while stirring. Pour in the hot water mixed with bouillon according to package instructions. Stir & bring to a boil. Once boiling, cover & reduce heat to low. Simmer for 20 mins until cooked. 4. Mix the salad ingredients in one bowl and the sauce ingredients in another bowl. Complete dinner in under 30 minutes✨ One pot, simple ingredients, minimal cleanup, and a dinner everyone actually gets excited about. Juicy chicken thighs, cozy penne pasta, and the freshest, creamiest side salad. These are the kinds of meals that end up on repeat in my kitchen because they’re easy, comforting, and just so good🥰 Ingredients 🐓🍝🥗 One pot chicken & pasta 1½ pounds boneless skinless chicken thighs/breast 1 onion, sliced ¼ cup olive oil 1 teaspoon salt 1 teaspoon paprika 1 teaspoon garlic powder ½ teaspoon black pepper 1 package 16 oz penne pasta  4 cups chicken broth or any broth you love ½ cup tomato paste Side salad 🥒🍅🥑 4 Persian cucumbers, chopped About a cup of cherry tomatoes  1 shallot  1 avocado  Olive oil Fresh lemon juice  Fresh lime juice  Salt and pepper Instructions Place the chicken thighs in a bowl. Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt, paprika, garlic powder, and black pepper. Mix until evenly coated. Heat a large pot over medium heat. Add the chicken and sear for a few minutes on each side until golden. Scatter the sliced onion right over the chicken and let it soften in all the flavor. In a separate bowl or measuring cup, whisk together the broth and tomato paste until smooth. Once the chicken is nicely browned, add the pasta directly into the pot. Pour the tomato broth mixture right over the chicken and pasta and bring everything to a boil. Cover, reduce to a simmer, and cook for about 10 minutes until the pasta is tender and the chicken is fully cooked through. While everything cooks, chop the cucumbers cucumbers, cherry tomatoes, shallot, and avocado. Drizzle with olive oil and fresh lemon and lime juice, season with salt and pepper, and toss. That’s it. One pot, one fresh salad, and a full comforting dinner on the table in under 30 minutes💛 #sivanskitchen #easyrecipes #onepotmeal #dinnerideas #quickmeals

Just to clarify, this video was never meant to be racist in any way. I was speaking purely from an artistic perspective. As I'm starting to learn coloring, I naturally find some skin tones more challenging to render than others. That doesn't mean I like them any less. In fact, both my mom's and my dad's sides of the family are Black. My mom herself has dark skin, so why would I dislike the same skin tone as my own family? The same goes for hair textures. I have naturally curly/coily hair, and from an artistic point of view, I personally find it more difficult to draw and render than straight hair. That doesn't mean I don't like it—in fact, I love my hair. It's simply about the technical challenge of drawing and coloring different features, nothing more. Please don't confuse artistic difficulty with personal preference or prejudice. They're two completely different things.  #dessin #black #fyp #drawing #fypシ゚

Hot Honey Chicken Tenders 🍯🔥  For all of you asking about the app I made (it’s free!!) you can search “osta” on the App Store or Google Play 😁 A little sweet, a little spicy and majorly crispy… served with buttermilk ranch.  For the Chicken: -2 lbs (0.9 kg) chicken breast, sliced into strips -2 cups buttermilk -1/3 cup pickle juice -Seasonings: 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp cayenne pepper, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp black pepper -Neutral oil, for frying Flour Mixture: -2 cups all-purpose flour +1/2 cup cornstarch -1 tsp baking powder -Seasonings: 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp paprika, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper Hot Honey Sauce: -1/4 cup butter -2 to 3 tbsps hot sauce -1/3 cup honey For the Ranch:  -1/2 cup mayonnaise + 1/2 cup sour cream -1/2 cup cold buttermilk (use less for a thicker dip) -1 teaspoon red wine vinegar  -1 teaspoon dried parsley -1 tbsp fresh dill weed (or 1 tsp dried dill) -Spices: 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp onion powder, 1/2 tsp fine sea salt, 1/2 tsp black pepper -1 tbsp fresh chives, optional Instructions: 1. Slice the chicken breasts into strips about 1 inch thick. Add to a mixing bowl with buttmilk, pickle juice, & chicken seasonings. Mix together. Cover & refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or overnight for extra tender chicken. 2. In a bowl, combine the flour, cornstarch, baking powder, and flour mixture seasonings. Mix. 3. Add neutral oil to a large pot until it is about 2–3 inches deep. Heat the oil to 350°F / 175°C. Keep the oil around this temp at all times.  4. Drizzle a little buttermilk marinade into the flour mixture & stir to create flaky bits. Shake excess marinade off the chicken, coat each piece in the flour mixture. Shake off extra flour & place into the oil. 5. Don’t touch them for the first 1–2 mins. Fry for 7–8 mins, or until golden brown and cooked through. Transfer to wire rack.  6. Meanwhile, melt butter over medium-low heat. Add honey and 2–3 tbsp hot sauce and whisk until smooth.  7. Mix the ranch ingredients in a bowl.  8. Toss or brush the tenders with the hot honey sauce. Serve with buttermilk ranch & enjoy! #cookingathometiktoktv #recipe #recipesoftiktok #easydinner

In a large, shallow pot, combine the water, gochujang, soy sauce, sugar, garlic powder, kimchi, and and curry powder (if using). Stir until the gochujang dissolves. Bring to a boil, then cook for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. 2. Arrange your add-ins in the pot, leaving out the ramen and cheese. Korean Popcorn Chicken 🍿🍗 For all of you asking about the app, search “Osta” on the app or Google play store ‼️🫶 The crispiest korean porocrn chicken… sweet, spicy and so simple. You can also make this in the air fryer!!🔥 For the Chicken: -2 lb chicken thighs or breasts, cut into 1 inch cubes -2 eggs -2 tbsp rice vinegar -6 garlic cloves, minced -1 tbsp fresh ginger, grated -Seasonings: 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp salt, 1 tsp black pepper, 1 tsp gochugaru (optional) -1/4 cup cornstarch -1/2 cup all-purpose flour -Neutral oil, for frying For the Sauce: -1.5 tbsp gochujang -2 tsp sesame seeds -3 tbsp ketchup -4 garlic cloves, minced -1.5 tbsp honey -3 tbsp butter -1 tbsp rice vinegar -1 tbsp soy sauce -2 tsp sesame oil -1 tsp gochugaru (optional) Garnish: -Sesame seeds -Green onions, sliced Instructions: 1. In a bowl, combine chicken with eggs, vinegar, garlic, ginger, & seasonings. Mix well & marinate as long as you wish (1 hour ideal, 1 min works). →For frying: add the cornstarch & flour directly into the same bowl and mix until evenly coated & sticky. →For air frying: do NOT add flour yet. You’ll coat it separately in step 2. 2. For frying: skip this step & go to step 3. For air frying: in a new bowl, mix cornstarch & flour. Remove chicken from marinade then toss in dry ingredients until fully coated. Press lightly so it sticks. 3. For frying: heat neutral oil to 350°F / 175°C. Fry in batches for 7–8 mins until golden and crispy, transfer to a rack. 4. For air frying: oil the basket & spray/brush the chicken with oil. Cook at 375°F for 8 mins, flip, cook for 6–8 mins more until crispy & cooked through. Work in batches. 5. In a pan over medium-low heat, combine gochujang, ketchup, sesame seeds, garlic, honey, rice vinegar, soy sauce, sesame oil, & optional gochugaru. Bring to a simmer, add butter, stir until melted, remove from heat. 6. Add the chicken directly to the sauce & toss OR in a mixing bowl, combine your desired amount of sauce with the chicken to control how saucy it gets. 7. Serve over jasmine rice, garnish with sesame seeds & green onions. Enjoy :) #recipesoftiktok #chicken #recipe #cookingathometiktoktv

I was called in to replace the fence panels and totally rip out the garden  (not the posts, they are a bit crooked but they are still standing😅)  I started with the fence panels, then began to totally clear the area of weeds and any other debris in the garden. Then we moved 4 tonnes of hardcore to the back through the house!  Backbreaking stuff.  Thanks to my pal @Wagwarn Abel for jumping on and giving me a hand 🙏 This is obviously unfinished but I think the owner was going to slab the rest himself, so our job is done here for now! As always I wanna know what would YOU do now? There's a bed at the back that's totally empty! Chicken Aflredo Burritos✨🍗🌯#cookingtips #recipeideas #easyrecipes #DinnerIdeas  #foodasmr  Recipe:  For the chicken: * 2–3 chicken breasts, cut into bite-sized cubes * Olive oil * Onion powder * Garlic powder * Paprika * Italian seasoning * Salt and pepper For the creamy garlic Parmesan sauce: * 2 tbsp butter * ½ white or yellow onion, diced * 5 cloves garlic, minced * 1 tbsp flour * 1½–2 cups heavy cream * ½ cup grated Parmesan * 1 handful shredded cheese of choice * Italian seasoning * Salt and pepper For assembling: * medium flour tortillas * Shredded mozzarella * ¼ cup fresh parsley, chopped * Extra Parmesan for garnish Instructions 1. Cut 2–3 chicken breasts into bite-sized cubes. Drizzle with olive oil and season with onion powder, garlic powder, paprika, Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper. Mix until well coated. 2. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and cook until golden brown and the internal temperature reaches 165°F. Remove from the pan and set aside in a bowl. 3. In the same pan, melt 2 tbsp butter. Add the diced onion and sauté until translucent. 4. Add the minced garlic and cook for about 30 seconds. Sprinkle in 1 tbsp flour and stir until everything is combined and the flour is cooked in. 5. Slowly pour in 1½–2 cups heavy cream. Add the Parmesan, shredded cheese, Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper. Stir everything together and let simmer until the sauce thickens slightly. 6. Pour about ¾ of the creamy sauce over the cooked chicken. Add ¼ cup chopped fresh parsley and mix until everything is evenly coated. 7. Add the chicken mixture to your tortillas, top with shredded mozzarella, and roll them up tightly. 8. Heat a little oil or butter in a skillet and fry the wraps on both sides until golden brown and crispy and the mozzarella is melted. 9. Garnish with fresh parsley and Parmesan. Serve with a side salad or broccoli and use the remaining creamy garlic Parmesan sauce for dipping!

This chicken recipe went viral for a reason… 🤤🍗 Almost 800K views later, and we’re STILL making it every Sunday! 😂 At this point, my family just knows what’s for dinner, and honestly, nobody’s complaining! It’s easy, packed with flavor, and turns out AMAZING every single time. Served over mashed potatoes with that delicious gravy?! SO GOOD! 🤌🏼 🍗 VIRAL CHICKEN THIGHS Ingredients: • Boneless chicken thighs • Salt & pepper • Garlic powder • Paprika • Italian seasoning • Olive oil • 1 onion, sliced • 2 cups chicken broth • Fresh thyme • Cornstarch + cold water (for gravy) Directions: 1. Preheat oven to 350°F. 2. Place chicken thighs in a baking dish. Season generously with salt, pepper, garlic powder, paprika, and Italian seasoning. 3. Drizzle with olive oil and toss to coat evenly. 4. Add sliced onion, pour 2 cups of chicken broth over everything, and add fresh thyme. 5. Cover tightly with foil and bake at 350°F for 90 minutes. 6. Remove from oven, take out the thyme, and carefully drain the cooking liquid into a separate bowl. 7. Mix cornstarch with cold water to make a slurry, then stir it into the cooking liquid. 8. Pour the gravy mixture back over the chicken. 9. Return to the oven UNCOVERED at 450°F for another 30 minutes! We love serving ours over mashed potatoes with roasted green beans and honey butter rolls! 🤎 SAVE this for your next Sunday dinner! I promise it’s one you’ll make again and again! Sticky Chicken Tender, seasoned chicken coated in a sweet and savory sticky sauce, served over warm rice and finished with green onions and sesame seeds. Ingredients For the Chicken 1.5 lbs chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces 1 teaspoon each onion powder, garlic powder, and teaspoon salt ½ teaspoon each black pepper and paprika  2 tablespoons olive oil About ⅓ cup cornstarch Olive oil, for cooking For the Sticky Sauce ½ cup soy sauce ⅓ cup brown sugar or honey 1 tablespoon hoisin sauce 1 tablespoon ketchup 1 teaspoon ginger paste ½ tablespoon minced garlic 1 tablespoon cornstarch 2 tablespoons butter For Serving Cooked white rice Sliced green onions Sesame seeds Instructions 1. Add the chicken to a large bowl and season with onion powder, garlic powder, salt, black pepper, and paprika. Add 2 tablespoons of olive oil and toss until the chicken is evenly coated. 2. Sprinkle about ⅓ cup cornstarch over the seasoned chicken and toss until each piece is lightly and evenly coated. This helps give the chicken that tender, velvety texture and creates a great coating for the sauce. 3. In a bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, brown sugar or honey, hoisin sauce, ketchup, ginger paste, minced garlic, and 1½ tablespoons cornstarch until smooth. Set aside. 4. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken in 2 batches so you don't overcrowd the pan. Cook until golden brown on the outside and cooked through. Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside. 5. Reduce the heat and add 2 tablespoons of butter to the same skillet, scraping up all those flavorful browned bits from the bottom of the pan. 6. Pour the prepared sauce into the skillet. Cook over low heat, whisking frequently, until the sauce begins to bubble and thickens into a glossy, sticky consistency. 7. Add the cooked chicken back to the skillet and toss until every piece is completely coated in the sticky sauce. 8. Spoon the sticky chicken over warm rice and finish with sliced green onion.  #easyrecipe #dinnerideas #quickrecipes #easydinner #dinnerrecipes

Here are three easy rotisserie chicken meals that are in my dinner rotation.  Just pick up a rotisserie chicken, or two, or three and make a meal prep out of it. I tried a new red enchilada sauce and it was seriously delicious. I was skeptical about the peanut butter, but then I was pleasantly surprised with how delicious it tasted. My entire family loved it!  Here are the recipes and instructions.  *Chicken Alfredo  3 tablespoons salted butter 3 garlic cloves, minced 1 teaspoon onion powder 4 cups heavy cream 1 cup shredded Parmesan cheese 1/2 teaspoon fine sea salt, plus more to taste 1/2 teaspoon ground black pepper, plus more to taste 1 tbsp parsley leaves 16 oz penne pasta  3-4 cups shredded chicken  1 broccoli head, cut into bite sized pieces    1. Cook pasta according to the package instructions until al dente, stirring occasionally.  2. While the pasta cooks, in a small saucepan over medium heat, melt the butter. Add the garlic and onion powder and whisk for 30 seconds, just until fragrant. Whisk in the cream and bring the mixture to a simmer. Reduce the heat to low and add the Parmesan. Whisk until the cheese is melted into the sauce, 1 to 2 minutes. Be careful not to let the sauce boil. Turn off the heat then season with salt and pepper. Add more if needed.  3. Add chicken, broccoli and pasta and toss until everything is coated.  Optional: add red pepper flakes for a little kick  *Chicken Noodle Soup  3 cups shredded chicken  3 Tbsp avocado oil  2 medium carrots,  sliced into thin circles 4 large sticks of celery, finely diced 1 small/medium onion, finely diced 8 cups chicken stock  4 cups water 4 medium potatoes,  peeled and cubed  2 bay leaves 2 Tbsp parsley 1 1/2 tsp fine sea salt, plus more to taste 1/2 tsp black pepper 1 1/2 cups egg noodle pasta, or use 3/4 cup small pasta  1 garlic glove, minced  Directions: 1. In a large soup pot over medium- high heat, add 2 Tbsp olive oil. Once oil is hot, add onions, carrots, and celery and sauté until softened and golden, stirring frequently for 5-7 minutes.  2. Add broth, water, potatoes, bay leaf, 1 1/2 tsp salt and 1/2 tsp black pepper. Bring to a boil and continue cooking at a medium boil for 10 minutes 3. Add pasta and chicken and cook for 5 minutes or until pasta and potatoes are tender. Add more salt and pepper to taste. 4. Press in 1 garlic clove and stir in parsley then remove from heat and enjoy.  *Green Sauce Enchiladas  15-20 corn tortillas (you can make as many or little as you want)  28 ounce can of Las Palmas Green Chile Enchilada Sauce  Avocado oil (enough to cover the bottom of a pan)  1/4 of an onion, diced  2 tsp dried oregano  1 to 2 cups shredded chicken  3/4 tbsps white vinegar  Directions: 1. Add oil to a pan and heat on medium/low heat.  2. Take a stack of 5-10 tortillas, wrap in a paper towel and microwave for a minute. Just enough to soften so they don't break when handled.  3. Once oil is hot, add the tortillas one by one and allow them to lightly fry (2 to 3 seconds) then remove from oil and place them on paper towels to drain.  4. Heat sauce in a medium sized sauce pan on low and bring to a simmer. Remove and set aside. 5. Chop 1/4 cup onion and add about 3/4 tbsp of white vinegar and dried oregano. Mix to combine and set aside.  Assemble: To eat right away- -dip oiled tortillas into sauce. Add shredded chicken and about 1 tsp of the onion, oregano, vinegar mixture then roll up tightly and place in pan with the seam side down. Repeat process with the remaining tortillas.  When you plate them, top with shredded lettuce, queso fresco, and a few slices of avocado. You can also add sour cream and hot sauce. 😉 To freeze them and serve later- *prepare everything the same way but DO NOT add the sauce. Heat and add the sauce when you are ready to eat them.  *Red Sauce Enchiladas  Recipe in comments. Save this for an easy weeknight meal you’ll keep coming back to 🌯💛 RECIPE⬇️ Creamy Chicken Mushroom Wraps Servings: 4 wraps Prep Time: 15 minutes Cook Time: 20 minutes Ingredients: For the Chicken: * 2 chicken breasts, diced * 1 tbsp olive oil * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tsp smoked paprika * ½ tsp black pepper * ½ tsp salt For the Mushroom Mixture: * 1 tbsp butter * 1 cup mushrooms, sliced * ½ medium onion, finely chopped For the Secret Sauce: * ¼ cup mayonnaise * 2+ tbsp creamy pasta sauce * 1 tsp sriracha (adjust to taste) Additional Ingredients: * 1 cup spinach, chopped * ¼ cup fresh cilantro, chopped * ½ cup shredded cheese (mozzarella, cheddar, or a blend) * 4 large tortillas Instructions: 1. Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the diced chicken and season. Cook for 8–10 minutes, or until the chicken is fully cooked and golden brown. Remove from heat and set aside. 2. In the different pan, melt the butter over medium heat. Add the sliced mushrooms and chopped onions, and sauté for about 5 minutes, or until softened and golden brown. 3. Add in the mayonnaise, creamy pasta sauce, and sriracha. 4. Return the cooked chicken to the pan with the mushroom mixture. Stir in the spinach and cilantro. Add the shredded cheese and stir until melted and combined. 5. Place a tortilla flat on a clean surface. Spoon a generous amount of the chicken and mushroom filling into the center. Fold in the sides and roll up tightly to form a wrap. 6. Heat a dry skillet over medium heat. Place each wrap seam-side down in the pan and toast for 1–2 minutes on each side, until golden brown and crispy. #nourished #nourished #homecooking #chickenwrap #mushroomchicken #easydinner #simpledinneridea #yummyeats #proteindinner #CapCut

videos.caption: Viral Chewy Potatoes with Spicy Orange Glaze 🥔🍊 Prep Time: 15 mins | Cook Time: 20 mins | Servings: 2-3 INGREDIENTS Potato Base 2-3 medium gold potatoes (peeled and roughly chopped) 1/2 cup + 1 tbsp water 3/4 cup tapioca starch 1/2 tsp salt Neutral oil for deep frying Spicy Orange Glaze 1/4 cup orange juice, freshly squeezed 1 tsp orange zest 2 tbsp gochujang (Korean chili paste) 1 tbsp honey or brown sugar 1 tbsp soy sauce 1 clove garlic, minced 1 tsp grated fresh ginger 1/2 tsp red pepper flakes or cayenne pepper (optional) 1 tsp sesame oil Garnish Fresh parsley, finely chopped INSTRUCTIONS 1. Place peeled and chopped gold potatoes and water into a blender. Blend on high until completely smooth with zero lumps. 2. Pour the blended potato mixture into a microwave-safe bowl. Microwave in 30-to-45-second intervals, stirring in between, for about 4–5 minutes total until it turns into a thick, glossy, sticky paste. 3. Stir salt and tapioca starch directly into the hot potato paste. Knead until a smooth, stretchy dough forms. Transfer the warm dough into a piping bag or a sturdy zip-top bag with a bottom corner snipped off. 4. In a small bowl, whisk together orange juice, orange zest, gochujang, honey, soy sauce, minced garlic, ginger, and red pepper flakes. Pour into a small saucepan over medium heat and simmer for 3–4 minutes until it reduces into a sticky, bright orange glaze. Turn off the heat and stir in sesame oil. Set aside. 5. Heat 2 inches of neutral oil in a deep pan to 325°F (165°C). Pipe short strands of potato dough directly into the hot oil, using kitchen scissors to snip them off. Fry in small batches for 2–3 minutes until puffed, cooked through, and very pale golden. Drain on a wire rack or paper towels for at least 5 minutes. 6. Increase the oil temperature to 375°F (190°C). Return the par-fried potatoes to the oil in small batches and fry for 1–2 minutes until deeply golden brown and extra crispy on the outside. Drain briefly. 7. Garnish with chopped parsley and serve immediately alongside the spicy orange glaze for dipping. #recipe #cooking #asmr #foodtok

Arsenio’s Chipotle Mac n Cheese Balls 🧀 Recipe👇🏽 Ingredients ½ lb (227 g) cavatappi pasta ¼ cup (57 g) butter ⅓ cup (40–45 g) all-purpose flour 1½ cups (360 ml) milk 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp paprika ½ tsp black pepper ¼ chicken bouillon cube, grated 1 tbsp chipotle pepper sauce 1 cup (100 g) shredded marble cheese 1 cup (100 g) shredded mozzarella 1 cup (100 g) extra shredded mozzarella for binding Salt to taste, if needed 2 eggs, beaten Panko breadcrumbs Oil for frying Instructions Cook the cavatappi in salted water until al dente, then drain well. Melt the butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Add the garlic powder, paprika and black pepper, then stir in the flour. Cook for 1–2 minutes, stirring constantly. Gradually whisk in the milk until smooth. Keep stirring until the sauce thickens enough to coat the back of a spoon. Add the grated chicken bouillon and chipotle pepper sauce. Turn off the heat, add the marble cheese and mozzarella, and stir until melted. Taste and add salt if needed. Mix the cooked pasta into the cheese sauce until everything is coated. Add the extra 1 cup of shredded mozzarella and mix until combined. Scoop portions onto pieces of parchment paper. Wrap the parchment around each portion and twist the ends to form tight balls. Place on a tray and freeze for about 1 hour, or until firm. Dip each ball into the beaten eggs, then coat generously in panko breadcrumbs. Heat the oil to 350°F (175°C). Fry until golden and crispy, making sure the centres are heated through. Larger balls may need extra time, so test one first. Transfer to a wire rack to drain. Let them cool slightly, break one open and enjoy that cheesy centre. I hope it crunches! ❤️

Tender stewed chicken and gravy recipe: Cook time: 80-90 mins  Servings: 6 Ingredients:  1/2 yellow onion  1/2 green bell pepper  1/2 red bell pepper  4 crushed garlic cloves  1/2 stick butter or olive oil  2 TBSP All purpose flour   6-8 boneless skinless chicken thighs  4 cups of chicken broth  Dried parsley  Seasonings: all purpose seasoning (such as natures seasoning or lawrys) onion & garlic powders, paprika, Italian seasoning, black pepper and if you don’t mind some spice toss in some Slap ya mama.  Directions: Season about 6-8 boneless skinless chicken thighs (depending on how many you’re serving) with all named seasonings. Marinate from 1 hour up to overnight. The longer the better. Use a Dutch oven or stock pot to sear the chicken in 2 TBSP of butter or olive oil. Sear for about 2-3 mins on each side on a medium high heat.  Remove chicken from pot. If you see little dark bits and pieces at the bottom of the pot leave it. It’s not burnt. That’s flavor that you want to keep in your pot to make the meal even more flavorful. It will deglaze and cook into the stew once you add your chicken broth.  In the same pot (without washing) on a medium heat add 1-2 TBSP of butter (depending on how much oil or butter you have left from searing the chicken). Add your peppers, onions and seasonings and cook down your peppers and onions for about 8-10 mins or until tender.  Once tender while still on a medium heat add in 1 TBSP of butter and whisk in 2 tbsp of flour to make a roux. Whisk frequently. Don’t walk away from your roux because this is A quick roux and can burn easily so watch it closely.  After about 5 mins you should have the color roux you want your gravy to be. For example if you want a dark brown gravy that roux should be dark brown.  After you’ve achieved that color add in 3 cups of chicken broth 1 cup at a time while stirring in between each cup. Season to taste with named seasonings.  Add in 3-4 crushed garlic cloves and a hefty TBSP of parsley. Put the lid on partially to bring this gravy to a simmer on a medium heat.  After about 10 mins add your chicken in and let it cook on a medium heat for 1 hour. Check it every 10 mins to make sure it doesn’t need more liquid. After your chicken is tender to your preference serve over rice or however you prefer.  **I served mine over white rice with loose, seasoned buttery corn and A blueberry loaf bread I made in the oven using Martha white blueberry cheesecake mix.  Enjoy ♥️

Roasted Garlic Parmesan Chicken & Rice Bake🔥598 cals 62g protein 21g fat 38g carbs Ingredients: This makes 4 meals 2 lb boneless, skinless chicken breast, cubed 1 cup dry jasmine rice (185g) 2 cups low-sodium chicken broth 1 block (8oz) reduced-fat cream cheese ½ cup freshly grated parmesan cheese  1 whole garlic bulb 1 tsp olive oil Fresh parsley for garnish Seasoning blend: 2 tsp garlic powder 2 tsp Italian seasoning 2 tsp onion powder 2 tbsp smoked paprika 1 tsp salt ½ tsp black pepper Directions: 1. Preheat your oven to 400°. In a 9×13 baking dish, add your uncooked jasmine rice and chicken broth. Stir everything together and spread the rice evenly across the bottom. 2. In a large bowl, add your cubed chicken breast along with the entire seasoning blend. Toss thoroughly until every piece is evenly coated. 3. Place your seasoned chicken evenly on top of the rice mixture, keeping the tops of the chicken exposed. Slice the top off your whole garlic bulb to expose the cloves. Drizzle with olive oil and place it cut-side up alongside the chicken. Cover the dish tightly with aluminum foil. 4. Bake for 40–50 minutes, or until the rice is tender and the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F. If the rice is still firm, add a splash of hot broth, cover, and continue baking until tender. 5. Remove the foil and squeeze the softened garlic cloves into the rice. Add your reduced-fat cream cheese and grated parmesan cheese, then mix everything into the hot rice until melted and creamy 6. Return to the oven uncovered for another 5–8 minutes. For a golden finish, broil for the final 1–2 minutes, watching closely. Garnish with fresh parsley, divide evenly into 6 meals, and enjoy! Follow for more #mealprep #roasted #chicken #parmesan #healthyrecipes

Creamy Chipotle Chicken & Potatoes🍗🍟🧀 One of the most indulgent meal prep recipes, so creamy, rich in flavour and packed with protein. Using a sheet pan is a game changer for batch cooking🔥 Macros Per Serving (6 Total) 548 Calories | 51g Protein | 52g Carbs | 17g Fat Ingredients (Makes 6 Servings) Chipotle Chicken Marinade - 1200g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs, trim excess fat - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 3 Tsp Parsley - 3 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 2.5 Tsp Cumin - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 100g Chipotle Paste - 1 and 1/2 Limes, juiced - 30g or 6 Tsp Olive Oil Let this marinate overnight if possible, way more flavor! Crispy Seasoned Potatoes - 1300g Raw Yellow Potatoes, cubed - 2.5 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Italian Herbs - 3 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 2.5 Tsp Onion Powder - Avocado Cooking Spray, heavy pass Creamy Chipotle Sauce - 20g Light Butter - 150-200g Red Onion, finely chopped - 1.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 60-80g Chipotle Paste (depends how spicy you want it) - 400g Light Evaporated Milk - 110g Light Cream Cheese - Freshly Chopped Parsley, garnish 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from chicken thighs. Add seasonings, chipotle paste, lime juice, and olive oil. Mix well and marinate. 2. Heat a large pan on low, add butter and chopped red onion. Cook for 5-7 mins until softened and lightly browned. Add seasonings and chipotle paste, mix, and cook for another 5 mins until caramelised. 3. Keep the heat low, add evaporated milk and cream cheese. Stir continuously until smooth, rich, and creamy. 4. Cube up potatoes, add seasoning and cooking spray, then mix well. Spread on a lined sheet pan and roast at 200C / 390F for 25 mins until golden and crispy. Season with salt, then fold into the sauce with fresh parsley until fully coated. 5. Spread marinated chicken on sheet pan, oven bake 25 mins 200C / 390F until golden and juicy. Cut into cubes, serve with creamy potatoes and ENJOY! . . . . #chipotle #chickenrecipes #mealprep #highprotein #healthyrecipes

videos.caption: Charlottes à la mousse au chocolat sans œuf et sans cuisson Ingrédients Pour le montage Biscuits boudoirs Lait pour imbiber les biscuits Pour la mousse au chocolat 175 g de lait et de crème 270 g de chocolat noir 312 g de crème liquide entière froide Préparation Le montage Tremper rapidement les boudoirs dans le lait, sans trop les imbiber pour éviter qu’ils ne deviennent mous. Disposer les biscuits tout autour du cercle, côté bombé vers l’extérieur, puis tapisser également le fond avec des boudoirs imbibés. Réserver. La mousse au chocolat Faire chauffer le mélange de lait et de crème jusqu’à ébullition. Verser le liquide chaud sur le chocolat préalablement coupé en morceaux. Laisser reposer quelques instants, puis mélanger jusqu’à obtenir une ganache lisse et brillante. Laisser tiédir. Monter les 312 g de crème liquide bien froide en chantilly souple. Incorporer délicatement la crème montée à la ganache au chocolat tiédie, en plusieurs fois, à l’aide d’une spatule, pour obtenir une mousse légère et aérienne. Le montage final Verser la mousse au chocolat dans le cercle préparé avec les boudoirs. Lisser la surface à l’aide d’une spatule. Placer au réfrigérateur pendant au moins 6 heures, idéalement toute une nuit, afin que la mousse prenne bien. Démouler délicatement avant de servir. 🇬🇧 Chocolate Mousse Charlotte (Egg-Free & No-Bake) Ingredients For the assembly Ladyfinger biscuits (boudoirs) Milk for dipping For the chocolate mousse 175 g milk and cream 270 g dark chocolate 312 g cold heavy cream Preparation Assembly Quickly dip the ladyfingers in milk, making sure not to soak them too much. Arrange the ladyfingers around the inside of the cake ring, with the rounded side facing outwards. Line the bottom with milk-dipped ladyfingers as well. Set aside. Chocolate mousse Heat the milk and cream mixture until it comes to a boil. Pour the hot mixture over the chopped chocolate. Let it sit for a few moments, then stir until smooth and glossy. Allow to cool slightly. Whip the cold heavy cream until soft peaks form. Gently fold the whipped cream into the cooled chocolate mixture in several additions, using a spatula until smooth, light and airy. Final assembly Pour the chocolate mousse into the prepared cake ring. Smooth the top with a spatula. Refrigerate for at least 6 hours, preferably overnight, until fully set. Carefully remove the ring before serving.

High Protein Cheesy Chicken Alfredo Rolls🍗🧀🌯 65g Protein Meal Prep💪🏼 (Macros: Per Roll - 10 Total) 438 Calories 25gC | 13gF | 65gP Want more recipes like this? check out my high protein cook books with over 300 recipes 👨🏻‍🍳📚 Ingredients:  1.7KG Boneless & Skinless Chicken Breast (raw weight) 1 Tsp Smoked Paprika, 1 Tsp Onion Powder, 1 Tsp Garlic Powder, 1 Tsp Salt 1 Tsp Olive Oil 1 Large Diced Brown Onion 4 Diced Garlic Cloves 450g Low Fat Cottage Cheese 35g Grated Parmesan Cheese 100ml Low Fat Milk 2 Tsp Italian Herb Seasoning, 1/2 Tsp Black Pepper, 1/2 Tsp Salt 60g Light Cream Cheese 10 Warm Tortillas (Mission Carb Balance Tortillas) 40g Light Mozzarella (per roll - 10 total) Egg Wash or Light Cooking Oil Spray Topping: Grated Parmesan Cheese & Parsley Flakes Instructions: 1. Slice chicken into fillets. Season with paprika, onion powder, garlic powder & salt, drizzle with olive oil and mix. 2. Cook in a pan over medium-high heat for approximately 4 mins per side or until cooked through. Set aside and dice. 3. Cook onion in the chicken juices until softened. Add garlic and diced chicken, mix well, then turn off the heat. 4. Blend cottage cheese, parmesan, milk, Italian herbs, salt & cream cheese until smooth. 5. With the heat completely off, add the sauce, mozzarella & parsley to the pan and mix well. 6. Add 1/10th of the filling to each warm tortilla, add mozzarella, then roll tightly. 7. Place on a lined baking tray. Brush with egg wash or spray with oil, then top with parmesan & parsley flakes. 8. Bake at 190°C/375°F for 8 – 12 mins or until golden brown & crispy. #chicken #alfredo #highprotein #healthyrecipes #mealprep

LAZY CINNAMON ROLL APPLE PIE 🍏🥧✨ This recipe has gone viral every time I’ve shared it over the years, it’s one of those warm, cozy classics that makes its way onto our table every holiday. Perfect for Thanksgiving, family get-togethers, or an easy Christmas morning breakfast! You can even prep it the night before and pop it in the oven the next morning! 🎄 Ingredients 🍏  1 can refrigerated cinnamon rolls (with icing) 1 can apple pie filling (21 oz) ¼ cup heavy cream 4 tbsp melted butter ½ cup brown sugar ½ cup all-purpose flour ½ tsp cinnamon DIRECTIONS🥧 1. Preheat your oven to 350°F. Pour the heavy cream into the bottom of a greased pie dish or baking dish. 2. Cut your cinnamon rolls into quarters and spread them evenly over the heavy cream. Spoon the apple pie filling right on top. 3. In a bowl, mix the melted butter, brown sugar, flour, and cinnamon until you get a crumbly, wet sand texture. Sprinkle evenly over the apples. 4. Bake for 30–35 minutes, or until golden brown and the cinnamon rolls are cooked through. Let cool slightly before drizzling with the icing from the cinnamon roll package! Serve warm with vanilla ice cream if you want to make it extra delicious! 🤎 TIP: You can use homemade apple pie filling or swap in your favorite canned pie filling! To prep ahead, assemble everything, cover, and refrigerate overnight, then bake fresh in the morning. You may need a few extra minutes in the oven! #easyrecipes #quickrecipe #cinnamonrolls #floridablogger #tastewithnicki

We thought we’d try sharing meal prep early for next week so you can plan ahead! Let us know if this timing is better! CHIPOTLE HONEY CHICKEN BOWLS CHICKEN 3 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs 1 can chipotle peppers in adobo* ¼ cup honey + more to drizzle ¼ cup olive oil + juice of 2 limes 1 Tbsp EACH garlic powder, onion powder + paprika 2 tsp EACH chili powder, cumin + oregano 1 Tbsp kosher salt + 1 tsp black pepper Add everything to chicken, toss well + marinate. Spread on a sheet pan, drizzle with a little more honey + bake at 425°F for 20–25 min or until 165°F. Broil briefly at the end if you want more char. *Spicy: use the whole can, peppers + sauce. Mild: use the adobo sauce but leave out the peppers. CILANTRO-LIME RICE 3 cups long-grain rice + ¾–1 cup warm chicken broth + ½ cup cilantro + juice of 2 limes + 2 Tbsp olive oil + salt. Cook rice; while HOT, add cilantro, lime, oil + salt, then slowly add broth while fluffing until absorbed. CORN SALSA 3 cups corn (canned or frozen) + 1 diced jalapeño + ½ diced red onion + ½ bunch chopped cilantro + juice 1–2 limes + S&P. Mix. BLACK BEANS 2 cans black beans + 1 tsp cumin + salt + splash chicken broth. Warm together. PICO 4 tomatoes + ½ red onion + ½ bunch cilantro, all diced + juice 1–2 limes + salt. Mix. SHEET-PAN BEEF KEBABS 3 lb ground beef 1 large white onion + 1 red bell pepper 6 garlic cloves + 1 bunch parsley 2 Tbsp paprika + 1 Tbsp cumin 2 tsp EACH coriander + turmeric 1 Tbsp kosher salt + 1½ tsp black pepper ½ tsp cinnamon (optional) Food-process onion, pepper, garlic + parsley until finely chopped. Transfer to cheesecloth + squeeze out as much liquid as possible. Add to beef with all spices + hand mix. Press evenly onto a sheet pan. Use a bench scraper to make deep kebab-style rows as shown in the video. Bake at 425°F for ~15 min, carefully drain excess liquid/fat, then broil 3–5 min until browned. ROASTED PEPPERS + ONIONS 2 red + 2 yellow bell peppers + 2 red onions + 1 bunch scallions + 2 tsp EACH paprika + cumin + olive oil + S&P. Slice, toss + roast at 425°F for 20–25 min until tender + charred. QUICK TZATZIKI 2 cups Greek yogurt + 1 grated cucumber + 1 grated garlic clove + juice 1 lemon + ¼ cup dill + salt. Mix. Brush pita with olive oil + grill until lightly charred. Fill with tzatziki, beef kebab + roasted peppers and onions. MAPLE SWEET POTATOES 6 sweet potatoes, halved + a little olive oil + maple syrup. Rub all over, place CUT-SIDE DOWN + roast at 425°F until tender + deeply caramelized. BROCCOLI Broccoli florets + olive oil + garlic powder + S&P. Roast at 425°F until browned + crisp around the edges. Full recipes on Substack! #m#mealprepm#mealprepideass#sheetpandinnerk#kebabsc#chipotleC@ChipotleS@Sur La Table

DUMP & BAKE SMOTHERED CHICKEN DINNER 🍗🤎 The kind of dinner that tastes like you spent all day in the kitchen, but really you just threw everything in a baking dish and let the oven do the work! Tender, juicy chicken smothered in homemade gravy with hardly any effort. Serve it over mashed potatoes or rice with your favorite sides and you’ve got yourself a good home-cooked meal! RECIPE BELOW ⬇️ Ingredients: 2 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs Olive oil Salt & pepper Garlic powder Onion powder Paprika Cajun seasoning (optional, for a little kick) 1 sprig fresh rosemary 2 tbsp butter 2 cups chicken broth Carrots or your favorite veggies 2 tbsp cornstarch + 2 tbsp water (use 3 tbsp of each for a thicker gravy) Directions: 1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Add chicken thighs and carrots to a baking dish. Drizzle with olive oil and season generously with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, and Cajun seasoning if using. Don’t be shy with the seasonings! This is where all your flavor comes from, so eyeball it and season heavily. 2. Add rosemary, butter, and chicken broth. Cover tightly with foil and bake at 350°F for approximately 50 minutes. 3. Remove from oven and carefully pour just the broth into a separate bowl or measuring cup. 4. Mix 2 tbsp cornstarch with 2 tbsp cold water to make a slurry. If you prefer a thicker gravy, use 3 tbsp cornstarch and 3 tbsp water instead. Stir the slurry into the hot broth until well combined, then pour everything back over the chicken and veggies. 5. Return to the oven uncovered at 400°F for approximately 20 minutes, or until the gravy has thickened and the chicken is tender and fully cooked (165°F internally). Serve over creamy mashed potatoes or rice with green beans, a warm dinner roll, or whatever your heart desires! That’s the beauty of cooking. Make it how YOU like it! 🤎 Save this one for an easy, comforting weeknight dinner! #easymeal #easyrecipe #momlife #fallvibes #smotheredchicken

french dip sandwiches on garlic butter pretzel buns ✨ Ingredients  Beef/Au Jus - 3 lbs chuck roast - 2 tsp onion powder (for beef) - 2 tsp garlic powder (for beef) - Salt and pepper, generously  - 5 cups beef stock - 6 garlic cloves - 3 rosemary sprigs  - 2 yellow onions, sliced - 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce  - 1 tbsp roasted beef bouillon paste - 1 1/2 tsp onion powder  - 1 tsp garlic powder  - 1/4 tsp msg (optional) - Salt to taste  - Avocado oil, for searing Caramelized onions  - 5 yellow onions, sliced  - 1 tbsp butter  - 1 tbsp neutral oil - 2 tsp granulated sugar  - Salt to taste Roasted garlic horse radish aoii - 1/2 cup mayonnaise - 1 whole head roasted garlic - 1–1 1/2 tbsp prepared horseradish (adjust to taste) - 1 tsp Dijon mustard - 1 tsp lemon juice - 1/2 tsp Worcestershire sauce - 1/4 tsp black pepper - Salt to taste Extras - Pretzel buns  - Garlic butter  - Provolone Cheese  Instructions - Pat the chuck roast dry and generously season all sides with salt, pepper, onion powder, and garlic powder. - Heat avocado oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Sear the beef on all sides until deeply browned.Remove and set aside. - the same pot, add the sliced onions and cook until softened, scraping up the browned bits from the bottom. - Add the onion powder, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Stir until fragrant. - Pour in the beef stock and stir, scraping the bottom of the pot to release all the flavor. - Add Worcestershire sauce, roasted beef bouillon paste, garlic cloves, and rosemary. Stir to combine. - Return the seared chuck roast to the pot. Bring to a gentle simmer, then cover and cook on low heat forapproximately 4 hours, turning the beef occasionally, until fork-tender and easily shreddable. - Remove the beef and shred with two forks. Strain the cooking liquid and reserve for dipping. Skim excess fat and adjust seasoning to taste. - Heat butter and neutral oil in a skillet over medium-low heat. - Add sliced onions, sugar and a generous pinch of salt. Cook slowly, stirring occasionally,for 35–45 minutes until deeply golden and caramelized. - Slice the pretzel buns and brush the insides with garlic butter. - Toast in a skillet until golden. - Spread roasted garlic horseradish aioli on the buns. Pile on the shredded beef, caramelized onions, and provolone cheese. Broil or cover briefly until the cheese is melted and bubbly. - Serve warm with the reserved beef au jus for dipping. • • • #recipes #recipeideas #fallrecipes #DinnerIdeas

VIRAL BROTHY BEEF BOWLS 🔥 If you love soup recipes, but want something substantial and super filling, these are one of the best easy weeknight meals. It’s so easy to make, so good, and packed with protei and flavor. These are super filling and come in under 500 calories and 35g protein a bowl. One of my favorite protein hacks is using a really good bone broth.That little Kettle & Fire carton has almost 20g of protein on its own, I used up a cup in the broth, and a cup making the rice instead of water to boost the protein + flavor. Here is how I made it: 1️⃣ Start with 1 lb ground beef in a large pan over medium-high heat. Break it apart as it browns, then add 4 minced garlic cloves, 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper, 1/4 tsp red chili flakes, and a generous pinch of salt. Brown it up really well. 2️⃣ For the broth, add 2.5 tbsp red curry paste and 2 minced garlic cloves to a saucepan over medium heat. Stir for 1-2 mins until softened and fragrant. 3️⃣ Pour in 3/4 cup half-and-half (or coconut milk) and 1 cup Kettle & Fire bone broth. Stir everything together until smooth and bring to a gentle simmer. 4️⃣ Season the broth with a generous couple pinches salt, fresh lime juice, and freshly chopped cilantro. Taste and adjust to your liking. You want it creamy, savory, a little spicy, and bright from the lime. 5️⃣ For the quick pickled red onions, super thinly slice 1/2 large red onion and add it to a bowl. Add juice of 1 lemon and sprinkle with sea salt. Mix really well with a fork and let sit 5-10 mins to soften. 6️⃣ Prepare 4 servings rice of choice. I love replacing the water in mine with bone broth for extra flavor + protein. 7️⃣ To assemble, add 3/4 cup cooked rice to a bowl, add 1/4 of the seasoned beef, and ladle 1/4 of the broth over everything. 8️⃣ Top with thinly sliced cucumbers, quick pickled red onions, sesame seeds, Korean chili flakes and plenty of finely chopped fresh cilantro. If you make it, let me know what you think on SHREDHAPPENS! ENJOY! 🙌 #healthyrecipes #healthyfoodshare #goodmoodfood

Sheet Pan Garlic Parmesan Chicken and Potatoes 🧄🧈 For ALL of you asking about the app, search “Osta” on the app or Google play store 🫶 Minimal effort, maximum flavor… juicy chicken, crispy potatoes covered in garlicky parmesan butter perfection 🔥 For the potatoes: - 1.5 lbs (680 g) baby potatoes - 1/3 cup butter, melted - 1 cup parmesan cheese - 8 garlic cloves, minced - Seasonings: 2 tsp each of paprika, oregano, garlic powder, salt, black pepper - 3 tbsp olive oil For the chicken: - 6 to 8 chicken thighs, boneless & skinless - Seasonings: 1 tbsp seasoning salt, 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp italian seasoning, 1 tsp cumin - 1 lemon, juiced - 2 tbsp mayonnaise For the garlic & onion: - 2 garlic heads + 2 tbsp olive oil + 2 tsp salt - 1 red onion, cut into chunks + olive oil, drizzled For the Aioli:  - 1/3 cup greek yogurt + 1/3 cup mayonnaise - 2 roasted garlic heads - 1/4 lemon, juiced - 2 tsp black pepper + 1 tsp salt - 3 tbsp chives, chopped For the Baste (optional ): - 1/4 cup mayonnaise  - 1/4 cup parmesan  - 2 tsp paprika Instructions: 1. In a bowl, combine the chicken, seasonings, lemon juice, garlic, and mayonnaise. Mix well and marinate for as long as you wish (up to overnight). 2. Preheat your oven to 375°F (190°C). Add the potatoes to a large casserole dish. Toss with the melted butter, parmesan, olive oil, garlic, and seasonings. Spread evenly. 3. Top with the chicken thighs. Add the red onion chunks around the dish & drizzle them with olive oil.  4. Slice the tops off the garlic heads, drizzle with olive oil and salt, wrap in foil, & place in dish. 5. Bake for 40 mins. Broil for the last 2–3 mins if desired.  6. Optional but recommended: Mix together mayo, parmesan, and paprika. At the 20-min mark, baste the chicken & return to the oven. 7. In a bowl, combine the yogurt, mayo, lemon juice, salt, pepper, and chives. Squeeze in as much of the roasted garlic as you wish OR chop them up first. Mix. 8. Finish with fresh parm, chives, & lemon slices. Enjoy! #recipe #cookingathometiktoktv #dinner #recipesoftiktok #dinnerideas

For the creamy chicken filling : 2 tbsp butter  1/2 cup yellow onion, finely chopped  1 tbsp fresh garlic, minced  2 cup rotisserie chicken , shredded  Salt to taste 1 tsp garlic powder  1/2 tsp black pepper powder  1 tsp paprika powder  1 tsp red chili flakes 1/4 cup unsweetened heavy whipping cream  5 tbsp cream cheese  1/4 cup green onion, chopped  1/4 cup Parmesan cheese , freshly grated  1 tbsp parsley, chopped  To assemble  6 sliced bread of choice  1 1/2 cup mozzarella cheese, shredded  Butter for toasting  Method: Melt the butter in a skillet over medium heat. Add the onion and cook for 4–5 minutes until soft and lightly golden. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Add the shredded rotisserie chicken, garlic powder, black pepper, paprika and chili flakes. Stir well and cook for 2 minutes so the seasonings coat the chicken. Lower the heat. Add the cream cheese and heavy cream, stirring until smooth and combined. Fold in the Parmesan. If the mixture is too thick, add heavy cream a teaspoon at a time. Stir in the green onion and parsley. Taste before adding salt. The mixture should be creamy and thick, not runny. Butter the outside of each bread slice. On the inside, layer mozzarella, a generous amount of creamy chicken, more mozzarella and the second slice of bread. Divide the filling and cheese evenly among three sandwiches. Cook over medium-low heat for about 3–4 minutes per side, until the bread is deeply golden and crisp and the cheese has melted. Cover the pan briefly if needed to help the center melt, then uncover to keep the crust crisp. Let each sandwich rest for about a minute before slicing and enjoy. #recipe #garlicparmesan #sandwich #cheese
