CREAMY GARLIC PASTA & STEAK RECIPE🍝🥩 Creamy, garlicky, packed with flavor, and ready in about 20 minutes. This rich tomato cream sauce paired with juicy steak is one of those meals that feels fancy but couldn’t be easier to throw together. Save this one for your next pasta night! ❤️🍝🥩 Creamy Garlic Pasta & Steak Recipe ⬇️  Ingredients 16 oz rigatoni 1 tbsp olive oil 2 tbsp butter 1 cup diced onion 4–5 garlic cloves, minced 4 tbsp tomato paste 2 tsp paprika 1 tsp Italian seasoning ½ tsp red pepper flakes Salt & pepper, to taste 2 cups heavy cream 1 cup reserved pasta water (plus more if needed) ½ cup grated Parmesan 2 strip steaks or ribeye Instructions 1. Cook the rigatoni according to the package directions, reserving 1 cup of pasta water before draining. 2. While the pasta cooks, season the steak with your favorite steak seasoning and let it sit at room temperature for 20–30 minutes. 3. Heat olive oil and butter in a large skillet. Add the onion and cook for 3–4 minutes, then stir in the garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant. 4. Add the tomato paste, paprika, Italian seasoning, red pepper flakes, salt, and pepper. Cook for 2–3 minutes, stirring often, until the tomato paste darkens slightly. 5. Pour in the heavy cream and whisk until smooth. Stir in the reserved pasta water and let the sauce simmer for 7–8 minutes. 6. Mix in the Parmesan until melted, then toss in the cooked rigatoni. Add a splash of extra pasta water if you’d like a thinner sauce. 7. Sear the steak in a very hot skillet for about 3–4 minutes per side (depending on thickness and desired doneness) until a golden crust forms. Let it rest for 10 minutes before slicing. 8. Top the creamy pasta with sliced steak and enjoy! #easyrecipe #quickmeal #mealprep #tastewithnicki #floridablogger

🍪 CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIE SHOTS 🤎 Cute little chocolate chip cookie shots, perfect for filling with cold milk. Makes 9 cookie shots. Ingredients: • 1½ cups (227 g) all-purpose flour • ⅓ cup (65 g) packed brown sugar • 2 tbsp + 2 tsp (33 g) granulated sugar • ½ tsp baking powder • Pinch of salt • 6 tbsp (88 g) butter • 1 large egg • 1 tsp vanilla paste • ½ cup + 1 tbsp (100 g) mini semi-sweet chocolate chips For the chocolate coating: • 120 g milk chocolate, melted Instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Lightly grease the cookie shot mold and inserts. 2. Mix flour, sugars, baking powder, and salt. 3. Melt butter and let cool slightly. Whisk in egg and vanilla paste. 4. Combine wet and dry ingredients, then fold in chocolate chips. 5. Divide dough into 9 balls. Place into the mold and press inserts firmly down. 6. Bake for 17–19 minutes with inserts in place. 7. Trim the edges while warm. Cool in the pan for 10 minutes, then gently remove inserts and let cool completely. 8. Melt 120 g of milk chocolate and coat the inside of each cookie shot. Let the chocolate set completely, then fill with cold milk and enjoy🤎 #cookies #chocolatechipcookies #dessertrecipes #viralrecipes #christmasdesserts

videos.caption: The Holiday Series: Episode 1 Maple Brown Butter Hasselback Butternut Squash with Whipped Hummus Ingredients (5-6 servings): For the Hasselback Butternut Squash: • 1 medium-large butternut squash (2-2 1/2 lb) • 1 tbsp olive oil • 1/2 tsp salt, or to taste • 1/4 tsp freshly ground black pepper • 1/4 tsp chili flakes  • 1/4-1/2 tsp paprika  Maple Brown Butter Glaze: • 4 tbsp (56 g) unsalted butter • 2-1/2 tbsp maple syrup • 1 tsp Dijon mustard • 1 tsp apple cider vinegar • 1 garlic clove, finely grated • 1/2 tsp finely chopped fresh thyme or rosemary  • 1/4 tsp red pepper flakes (optional) • Pinch of salt Whipped Hummus: • 1 can (15 oz) chickpeas, drained and rinsed • 1 tbsp tahini • 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice • 1 tbsp extra-virgin olive oil • 1/2 tsp salt, or to taste • Freshly ground black pepper • 3-5 tbsp cold water, as needed For Garnishing: • 1/3 cup pistachios, roughly chopped • 1/4 cup pomegranate arils • Fresh thyme leaves • Flaky sea salt Instructions: 1. Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C) and line a large baking sheet with parchment paper. 2. Peel the butternut squash (remove the pale, fibrous layer beneath the skin), cut it into two halves, and scoop out the seeds. Place each half cut-side down on a cutting board, and place two chopstick on either side. Using a sharp knife, make thin slices ~1/8” (3 mm) apart across the squash.  3. Carefully transfer the squash halves to the prepared baking sheet, cut-side down. Brush with olive oil and season with salt, black pepper, paprika, and chili flakes. Roast for 35 minutes, until the squash begins to soften but still holds its shape. 4. Meanwhile, make the maple brown butter glaze. Melt the butter in a small saucepan over medium heat. Continue cooking until it foams, and develops golden-brown specks, and smells nutty. 5. Immediately remove the saucepan from heat and transfer the brown butter to a heatproof bowl. Stir in the maple syrup, Dijon mustard, apple cider vinegar, grated garlic, rosemary/thyme, red pepper flakes, and a pinch of salt. Mix until combined. 6. Remove the squash from the oven  after the first roast, brush generously two-thirds of the maple brown butter glaze over the tops and sides, and return the squash to the oven.  7. Continue roasting for another 25 minutes, or until the squash is fork-tender and beautifully caramelized. Baste the squash with the glaze once or twice, and start checking after 15 minutes. 8. While the squash roasts again, prepare the whipped hummus. For an extra-smooth texture, simmer the drained chickpeas in water for 10 minutes, and drain them. You can skip this step if you want. 9. Add the chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and black pepper to a food processor or high-speed blender. Blend until smooth, then gradually add cold water one tablespoon at a time, until the hummus becomes creamy. Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed. 10. Spread the whipped hummus across a large serving platter, and make a thick bed. Carefully transfer the roasted squash halves onto the hummus using wide spatulas. Gently warm the reserved maple brown butter glaze if necessary and brush it all over the squash for a glossy finish. 11. Garnish with pistachios, pomegranate, fresh thyme, and a sprinkle of flaky sea salt. Enjoy! #squash #holidayrecipes #thanksgivingrecipes #easyrecipes #hasselbacksquash

Artist Casey Curran creates kinetic sculptures that combine mechanical systems with forms inspired by plants and natural structures. In this prototype, layers of delicate petals are connected so that a single mechanical action produces a rippling movement across the entire structure. Instead of every element moving independently, the motion travels through the sculpture like a wave. This type of movement is central to Curran’s practice. Using motors, wires, cranks and carefully engineered mechanisms, he creates artificial flowers and organisms that bloom, flutter and contract.  The machinery is artificial, but the movement feels strangely organic ,engineering becomes a way of imitating the rhythms of living systems. #art #artist #fashion #avantgarde #design

Here’s how to make Umma’s restaurant-quality Korean Fried Chicken. One of the best fusions to exist. Perfect for Friendsgiving  as long as it’s served warm and fresh. Full recipe from our cookbook, UMMA, pg. 200. Link in bio to purchase if you want to support! Sweet & Spicy Sauce recipe on pg. 201. Recipe in the comments since it’s maxed out here. INGREDIENTS: 3 pounds (1.4kg) chicken wings, cut at joints, wingtips discarded (we just use Costco Party Wings and use it as is) 2 1/2 cups milk  2 teaspoons black pepper, divided  1 teaspoon miwon matsogeum (MSG seasoning salt)  3 1/2 cups (462g) Korean frying mix, divided (Beksul by CJ Foods) 5 tablespoons (50g) curry powder, divided (Ottogi in Medium) 1 tablespoon Dasida beef stock powder  1 tablespoon garlic powder  1 tablespoon onion powder  1 1/2 cups cold water  2–3 qt vegetable oil for frying  INSTRUCTIONS summarized to fit: 1. Rinse and drain the chicken, then transfer it to a large bowl. Submerge in milk, cover, and refrigerate for 1 hour.  2. Drain and thoroughly rinse the chicken until the water runs clear. Pierce each wing 3–5 times on each side around the bone, all the way through. Pat dry and transfer to a bowl.  3. Toss with 1 tsp pepper and seasoning salt. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours or overnight.  4. Heat oil to 330°F. Whisk 1½ cups (198g) frying mix, 3 Tbsp curry powder, Dasida, garlic powder, and onion powder. Gradually whisk in cold water until just combined; small lumps are fine. Coat chicken in batter.  5. Mix remaining 2 cups (264g) frying mix, 2 Tbsp curry powder, and 1 tsp pepper. Working one wing at a time, let excess wet batter drip off, then coat in the dry mixture without pressing. Tap the wing against the bowl twice to “shock” it, creating its signature wave pattern. Lower each wing halfway into hot oil for 2-3 seconds, then release. Fry 6 wings per batch, undisturbed for 2 minutes, then turn occasionally until golden, crispy, and at least 165°F inside (5–7 minutes for wingettes, 7–10 for drumettes). 6. Transfer the wings to the prepared rack as they finish cooking. Return the oil to 330 degrees and repeat with the remaining wings in batches. Serve w sauce as dip. #koreanfriedchicken #friedchicken #chickenrecipes #friendsgiving #protein

My sister-in-law’s famous Thanksgiving mashed potatoes 🥔 I’m also releasing a completely free Thanksgiving cookbook with recipes for every staple Thanksgiving dish you need for the big day. Everything is easy and doable without sacrificing flavor. Coming very soon, so follow my page so you don’t miss it Ingredients • 5 lb Yukon gold potatoes • 16 oz cream cheese, softened • ⅓ cup sour cream • ½ cup milk • 1 stick butter, softened, plus extra slices for topping • 1 tsp black pepper • 2 tsp salt • Paprika, for topping • 1 bunch fresh chives, chopped Instructions 1. Set out the cream cheese and butter to soften. Preheat the oven to 400°F. 2. Boiling Method: Peel the potatoes and cut into evenly sized chunks. Place in a large pot, cover with cold water, and bring to a boil. Reduce to a simmer and cook for 15–20 minutes, or until fork-tender. 3. Instant Pot Method (Alternative): Add 1 cup of water to the Instant Pot and place the trivet inside. Add the whole, unpeeled potatoes. Pressure cook on high for 14 minutes, then allow a 10-minute natural pressure release before releasing the remaining pressure. Carefully remove, cool slightly, and peel. Cook in batches if necessary. 4. Transfer cooked potatoes to a large mixing bowl. Add cream cheese, sour cream, milk, butter, salt, and pepper. 5. Use a hand mixer or stand mixer to mix until smooth and creamy, being careful not to overmix. 6. Transfer to a greased 9×13-inch baking dish and spread evenly. 7. Sprinkle paprika over the top and add a few thin slices of butter. 8. Cover tightly with aluminum foil. 9. Bake at 400°F for 60 minutes, or until heated through. 10. Remove the foil during the final 5 minutes to lightly brown the top. 11. Sprinkle the freshly chopped chives over the top before serving. Make-Ahead Instructions 1. Prepare the mashed potatoes following steps 1–8 above, using either cooking method. Wait to preheat the oven until you’re ready to bake. 2. Cover tightly with foil and refrigerate for up to 2 days. 3. Remove from the refrigerator 30 minutes before baking. 4. Preheat oven to 400°F. 5. YALL COME EAT it’s my viral sausage tortellini. 🤤  This recipe has nearly 5 million views on TikTok, so I thought it was time for an official step-by-step.  1. Cook 1 bag of tortellini according to the package directions. Drain and set aside. 2. Add 2 packs of sliced andouille sausage and cook until browned and heated through. Remove the sausage and set aside. 3. In the same skillet, add 1 small finely chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3–4 minutes. Add 2 cloves minced garlic and cook for another 30 seconds. 4. Add 8–10 halved cherry tomatoes, 2 tablespoons chopped sun-dried tomatoes and 1 tablespoon tomato paste. Stir everything together and cook for 2–3 minutes. 5. Season with 1 teaspoon oregano, 1 teaspoon basil, 1 teaspoon parsley, 1 teaspoon smoked paprika, 1 teaspoon garlic powder and 1 teaspoon onion powder. Add salt and pepper to taste. 6. Pour in 1 cup heavy cream and stir to combine. Bring the sauce to a gentle simmer, then add ½ cup shredded Parmesan cheese. Stir until the Parmesan melts and the sauce becomes creamy. 7. Add 1 cup roughly chopped spinach and stir until wilted. 8. Add the cooked tortellini and browned andouille sausage back into the skillet. Toss everything together until the tortellini and sausage are completely coated in the creamy sauce. Cook for another 1–2 minutes. 9. Garnish with red chili flakes and additional Parmesan cheese, if desired. #viralrecipe #tortellini #easydinnerideas #pastarecipe #familymeal

Ingredients: • Boneless chicken thighs • Salt & pepper • Garlic powder • Paprika • Italian seasoning • Olive oil • 1 sliced onion (I use less!) • 2 cups chicken broth • Fresh thyme • Cornstarch + cold water (for gravy) Directions: 1. Place chicken thighs in a baking dish and generously season both sides with salt, pepper, garlic powder, paprika & Italian seasoning. 2. Drizzle with olive oil and add sliced onions. 3. Mix cornstarch with cold water to make a slurry, then stir into the liquid. 6. Pour the gravy mixture back over the chicken. 7. Bake UNCOVERED at 450°F for another 30 minutes, until the chicken is beautifully browned and the gravy thickens! Cherry blossoms are among the most beautiful and admired flowers in the world. Known for their soft pink and white petals, these delicate blooms appear during the spring season and symbolize renewal, hope, beauty, and the short but meaningful nature of life. Cherry blossom trees, often called sakura in Japan, have become deeply connected to culture, art, poetry, and traditions across many countries. Every year, millions of people gather in parks, gardens, and streets to witness the brief but breathtaking blooming season that transforms landscapes into seas of pink and white. Cherry blossoms bloom for only a short period, usually lasting one to two weeks depending on weather conditions. This short life span is one reason they are so admired. Their beauty reminds people that life itself is temporary and precious. In Japanese culture, cherry blossoms represent the idea of living in the moment and appreciating beauty while it lasts. Festivals called hanami, meaning “flower viewing,” are held during the blooming season. Families and friends gather beneath the trees for picnics, music, laughter, and celebration while enjoying the falling petals drifting through the air like soft pink snow. The history of cherry blossoms dates back thousands of years. In ancient Japan, emperors and nobles admired the blossoms and wrote poetry inspired by them. Over time, the tradition spread throughout society and eventually became known around the world. Today, cherry blossom festivals are celebrated in many countries including the United States, South Korea, and China. One of the most famous celebrations outside Japan takes place in Washington, D.C., where thousands of cherry blossom trees bloom around the Tidal Basin each spring. These trees were gifted by Japan in 1912 as a symbol of friendship between nations.#fyp #fyp #fypシ゚viral #foryou #japan

BAKED MAC N CHEESE🧀🦃 DAY 1 of my Thanksgiving Side Dish Series! 🦃🧀 Starting off strong with my homemade Baked Mac & Cheese because you simply cannot have Thanksgiving without mac & cheese! Creamy, cheesy, and loaded with FIVE different cheeses. 🤤 Ingredients: 24 oz elbow macaroni 6 tbsp butter 6 tbsp all-purpose flour 2 cups whole milk 3 cups heavy cream 8 oz sharp cheddar, shredded 8 oz Colby Jack, shredded 8 oz medium cheddar, shredded 8 oz mozzarella, shredded 4 oz Gruyère, shredded Seasonings: 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder 1 tsp ground mustard 1 tsp paprika ½ tsp black pepper 1 tsp salt (or to taste) Directions: 1. Boil macaroni in salted water for about 6 minutes, just shy of al dente. Drain and set aside. It’ll finish cooking in the oven! 2. In the same pot, melt butter over medium-low heat. Whisk in flour and cook for 2–3 minutes, stirring constantly to remove the raw flour taste without browning. Stir in seasonings. 3. Slowly whisk in milk until smooth, followed by heavy cream. Cook for 5–8 minutes, stirring frequently, until warmed through and slightly thickened. Don’t let it boil! 4. Turn OFF the heat! This is key! Adding cheese over high heat can cause the proteins to tighten and the oils to separate, leaving you with a grainy, greasy sauce instead of a smooth, creamy one. Gradually stir in HALF your shredded cheese until melted and silky. 5. Fold in macaroni until completely coated. In a greased 9x13 baking dish, layer half the macaroni, half the remaining cheese, the rest of the macaroni, and finish with the remaining cheese. 6. Bake at 350°F for 15–20 minutes until hot and melted. Keep an eye on it! For that golden, crispy cheesy top, broil on high for 2–3 minutes, watching closely. And that’s it! The perfect cheesy, creamy Thanksgiving side dish! 🧀🤎 SAVE this recipe for your Thanksgiving menu! 🦃 #bakedmac #thanksgivingrecipes #thanksgiving #sidedish #floridablogger

Garlic Herb Grilled Chicken Bowl🍗🧄🍚🥗 Juicy Middle Eastern grilled chicken served with fluffy spicy rice, refreshing tabbouleh, and a smooth, spicy garlic cream sauce. Every bite is loaded with flavour🤌🏽 Macros Per Serving (6 Total) 650 Calories | 52g Protein | 59g Carbs | 22g Fat Ingredients (Makes 6) Middle Eastern Chicken - 1200g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 4 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 4 Tsp Oregano - 3 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Paprika - 3 Tsp Cumin - 30g Honey - 80-100g Tomato Paste  - 1 Lemon Juice  - 30g Olive Oil Golden Herb Rice - 300g Uncooked Basmati Rice (Cook this beforehand) - 20g Light Butter - 100g White Onion, finely chopped - 1 Tsp Salt - 3 Tsp Italian Herbs - 1.5 Tsp Turmeric - 1 Tsp Paprika - 1 Tsp Cumin Tabouleh Salad - 3 Cups Parsley, chopped - 300g Tomato, chopped and de-seeded - 150g Green Onion/Scallion, chopped - 15g Olive Oil - Lemon Juice - 1/2 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Sumac - 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes Spicy Garlic Sauce - 300g Low Fat Yogurt - 100g Light Mayo - 120g Chilli Garlic Sauce (Lee Kum Kee) - 1 Tsp Paprika  - 1 Tsp Onion Powder - 1/4 Cup Evaporated Milk 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from chicken thighs. Add the Middle Eastern spice mix, honey, tomato paste, lemon juice and olive oil. Mix well and marinate. 2. Heat a pan over low heat. Add light butter and chopped onion, cook for 5 mins until softened. Stir in the seasoning and toast for 3-4 mins . Add cooked basmati rice, turn off the heat and mix until fluffy and golden. 3. In a bowl, combine chopped tomato, green onion, parsley, olive oil, seasoning and lemon juice. Mix well and refrigerate until ready to serve. 4. Spread the chicken on a lined sheet pan and oven bake at 200C / 400F for 20-25 mins, then broil/grill for 5 mins until golden and juicy. 5. WHAT YOU’LL NEED: Honey Garlic Chicken • 800g chicken breast, cubed • 1.5 tsp salt • 1 tsp black pepper • 1 tsp chilli flakes • 1.5 tsp garlic powder • 1.5 tsp onion powder • 1.5 tsp smoked paprika • 2 tsp olive oil • 30g light butter • 2 tsp minced garlic • 30g honey • Handful fresh parsley, chopped Garlic Mac & Cheese • 220g uncooked macaroni • 1 large tbsp minced garlic • 300ml skimmed milk • 160g light cream cheese • 1 tsp salt • ½ tsp black pepper • 1 tsp smoked paprika • ½ tsp nutmeg • 100g low-fat cheddar cheese HOW TO MAKE IT: 1. Season the chicken with salt, black pepper, chilli flakes, garlic powder, onion powder and smoked paprika. 2. Heat a pan over medium heat with the olive oil and some of the butter. Add the chicken and cook for 4–5 minutes until golden, flip and cook for another 3–4 minutes until cooked through. 3. Lower the heat and add the remaining butter, minced garlic and honey. In the same pan, cook the minced garlic in the leftover buttery goodness for around 2 minutes. 6. Add the skimmed milk, light cream cheese, salt, black pepper, smoked paprika and nutmeg. Stir until smooth. 7. Lower the heat, add the cheddar and stir until melted. Add the cooked macaroni and give the whole thing another mixy mixy motherfucker! 8. Serve the mac & cheese topped with the sticky honey garlic chicken and finish with fresh parsley. MACROS PER SERVING: 597 Calories | 59g Protein | 52g Carbs | 16g Fat SERVINGS: 4 Cheers: @jalalsamfit

Creamy Tuscan Chicken Rigatoni 🍝 Recipe ⬇️ Juicy, perfectly seasoned chicken over rigatoni tossed in a creamy garlic Parmesan sauce loaded with sun-dried tomatoes, spinach, and fresh veggies. And yes, we're pouring even more sauce over the chicken! INGREDIENTS CHICKEN + 1 lb chicken breasts + 1 tsp smoked paprika + 1 tbsp garlic powder + 1 tsp Italian seasoning + 1 tsp black pepper + ½ tsp salt + 1 tbsp avocado oil PASTA + 10 oz rigatoni + ½ cup reserved pasta water, plus more as needed CREAMY TUSCAN SAUCE + 2 cups heavy cream + 1½ tbsp butter + 2 tbsp cooking oil + 1 shallot, diced + 10 garlic cloves, minced + ½ red bell pepper, diced + 12 cherry tomatoes, halved + ⅓ cup sun-dried tomatoes, chopped + 1 cup freshly grated Parmesan + 1 cup baby spinach + ¾ tsp chicken bouillon powder SAUCE SEASONINGS + ½ tsp smoked paprika + ½ tsp garlic powder + ½ tsp black pepper + ½ tsp Italian seasoning + ¼ tsp red pepper flakes + Salt to taste FINISHING + 1–2 tsp fresh lemon juice (optional) + Fresh parsley + Extra Parmesan DIRECTIONS + STEP 1: SEASON & SEAR Butterfly chicken into cutlets and coat with seasonings. Sear in avocado oil over medium-high heat for 3–5 minutes per side until golden and 165°F internally. Remove and rest. + STEP 2: COOK THE PASTA Cook rigatoni in salted water until al dente. Reserve pasta water before draining. + STEP 3: SAUTÉ THE VEGGIES In the same skillet, add butter, oil, shallot, and bell pepper. Cook 3–4 minutes. Add garlic, cherry tomatoes, and sun-dried tomatoes. Cook another 2–3 minutes. + STEP 4: MAKE THE SAUCE Reduce heat to medium-low. Add heavy cream, ½ cup pasta water, bouillon, and all sauce seasonings. Simmer 3–4 minutes. Reduce heat to low and gradually stir in Parmesan until smooth. + STEP 5: COMBINE Reserve ¾ cup sauce for drizzling. Add spinach to the skillet and cook until wilted. Toss in rigatoni, adding pasta water as needed. Finish with lemon juice if desired. + STEP 6: SERVE Slice chicken and arrange over the pasta. Drizzle with reserved creamy sauce and finish with Parmesan and parsley. Enjoy! #tuscanchicken #chickenpasta #rigatoni #pastarecipe #comfortfood

An aquarium’s filter does far more than keep the water looking clean. It continuously removes waste, circulates oxygen, and provides a home for beneficial bacteria that break down harmful toxins produced by fish and uneaten food. Without proper filtration, ammonia and other toxic compounds can quickly build up, turning a healthy aquarium into a dangerous environment for its inhabitants. A good filtration system helps maintain water quality, stabilize the ecosystem, and keep fish healthy over the long term. While decorations and lighting may catch the eye, the filter is the unseen engine that keeps the entire aquarium alive.

🍫 Knock Me Naked Cake A rich, chocolatey Butterfinger poke cake loaded with sweetened condensed milk, Cool Whip, and caramel! Ingredients 1 box Duncan Hines Devil’s Food Cake Mix 4 eggs 1 cup milk 1 stick butter, melted 1 can sweetened condensed milk 1 bag fun-size Butterfinger candy bars, crushed 2 containers Cool Whip Caramel sauce, for drizzling Instructions 1. Prepare the cake: Preheat your oven to 350°F. Mix together the cake mix, eggs, milk, and melted butter until well combined. Pour into a greased 9×13-inch baking dish. 2. Bake: Bake for 29–30 minutes, depending on your oven, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. 3. Poke & pour: While the cake is still warm, poke holes all over the top. Pour the entire can of sweetened condensed milk evenly over the cake, allowing it to soak into the holes. 4. Add the Butterfingers: Crush the entire bag of fun-size Butterfinger candy bars. Sprinkle half of the crushed candy over the cake and save the remaining half for topping. 5. Cool completely: Allow the cake to cool completely before adding the topping. 6. Finish it off: Spread both containers of Cool Whip evenly over the cake. Sprinkle the remaining crushed Butterfingers on top and finish with a generous drizzle of caramel sauce. 7. Refrigerate & serve: Cover and store the cake in the refrigerator until ready to serve. Keep any leftovers refrigerated. 🤎 Kalyn’s Tip: This cake is delicious served cold! Give it time to chill so all that sweetened condensed milk can soak into the chocolate cake. #KnockMeNakedCake #ButterfingerCake #PokeCake #SouthernDesserts #EasyDessert

videos.caption: Smothered Green Beans 🫛🥓🥔 FULL RECIPE BELOW ⬇️  A delicious side dish that I have to have on the table for holiday meals! Hope y’all enjoy this one 🙌🏿🔥  Ingredients:  Green Beans- ~ 44oz Petite Golden Potatoes - 24oz bag Onion- 1 Red Bell Pepper- 1 Garlic- 4 cloves Bacon- 12oz Beef Smoked Sausage- 12oz Flour- 3 tbsp Chicken Stock (low sodium)- 7 cups Chicken Bouillon- 1 tbsp Salt- 1 tbsp White Pepper- 1 tbsp Onion Powder- 1 tbsp Garlic Powder- 1 tbsp Paprika-  2 tbsp Complete Seasoning or All Purpose Seasoning (salt free)- 2 tbsp Worcestershire Sauce- 1 tbsp Hot Sauce- 2 tbsp Cornstarch (for slurry)- 1 tbsp Water (for slurry) - 1 tbsp   Method:  Prep your ingredients before you start cooking to make the process smoother includes: chopping onions, garlic and peppers, chopping up the bacon and sausage, snipping and washing green beans, and cutting the golden potatoes in half.    Cook the bacon in a big pot on medium heat while constantly stirring allowing it to cook in its own fat. Once its crispy, remove from the pan and go in with the sliced sausage cooking until crispy, then remove.    Into the same pot add the onions and peppers and cook until translucent then add in the chopped garlic and cook until fragrant. Once its cooked start a roux by adding flour and fully combining.    Slowly pour and stir chicken stock into the roux. Once fully incorporated season the gravy with the seasonings listed above along with hot sauce and worcestershire sauce.    Add in the green beans and fully combine, then cover with a lid and cook on medium for about 45 minutes. Take the lid off and add in the potatoes. Cover with a lid again for about 30 minutes or until the potatoes are fork tender.    Add the cornstarch slurry in and allow the gravy to thicken up and you should be set! Be sure to add a little salt at the end (to taste). Then add to a serving dish or directly to your plate and dig in. Enjoy!  #homecooking #holidaydishes #foodtok #fyp #easyrecipe

Viral Pepperoni Pizza Caesar Wrap Recipe 🍕 made this wrap for dinner and my family enjoy it! It’s like having a pizza and a Caesar salad together but without the carbs☺️ Makes 2 wraps Ingredients For the Cheese Wraps * 1½ cups freshly grated part-skim low-moisture mozzarella cheese * 14–16 pepperoni slices * sprinkle with oregano and red pepper flakes For the Caesar Salad * 1 head romaine lettuce * ¼ cup crushed croutons * Extra parmesan cheese, for topping For the Caesar Dressing * ¼ cup Best Foods mayonnaise * ¼ cup 0% Greek yogurt * Juice from ½ lemon * 2 tsp Worcestershire sauce * 1½ tsp Dijon mustard * 1 large garlic clove, grated * ¼ cup grated parmesan cheese * ¼–½ tsp black pepper Directions 1. Preheat oven to 375°F. 2. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Spread ¾ cup freshly grated part-skim low-moisture mozzarella into a thin tortilla-sized circle. Top each with 7–8 pepperoni slices and sprinkle with the oregano and red pepper flakes. 3. Bake for 10-12 minutes or until crispy around the edges and golden brown. 4. Slice the romaine lettuce lengthwise, chop into thin strips, rinse under cold water, and dry very well using a salad spinner. 5. In a bowl, mix together the mayonnaise, Greek yogurt, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, Dijon mustard, garlic, parmesan, and black pepper. 6. Toss the romaine with most of the dressing, crushed croutons, and parmesan cheese. 7. Let the wraps cool slightly, then fill with the Caesar salad. Top with extra parmesan, croutons, and dressing if desired. #dinnerideas #easydinners #caesarsalad #pizza #wrap

Creamy Peri Peri Chicken Pasta🍗🧀🍝 Another game changing sheet pan meal prep. This pasta tastes unreal, low effort, easy to make for the week!🤌🏽🔥 Macros Per Serving (8 Total) 592 Calories | 55g Protein | 54g Carbs | 19g Fat Ingredients (Makes 8 Servings) Peri Peri Chicken - 1500g Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, fat trimmed - 3 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 4 Tsp Oregano - 4 Tsp Garlic Powder - 4 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 2 Tbsp Freshly Chopped Parsley - 2 Tbsp Freshly Chopped Coriander/Cilantro - 1 Lemon Juiced - 8 Tsp Olive Oil - 100g Nando’s Peri Peri Medium Sauce (used to brush over the chicken before cooking) - Avocado Cooking Spray (4 Tsp worth) Creamy Peri Peri Pasta - 200-250g White & Red Onion, chopped - 200-250g Red & Green Bell Pepper, chopped - 1.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Garlic Powder - 2 Tsp Oregano - 2 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 120-150g Tomato Paste - 180g Light Cream Cheese - 400ml Light Evaporated Milk - 150g Peri Peri Medium Sauce - 480g Uncooked Protein Rigatoni Pasta / ~800-900g Cooked Pasta - Fresh Chopped Parsley 👨‍🍳 Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from the chicken thighs. Add seasoning, fresh parsley and coriander, lemon juice, and olive oil. Mix until evenly coated and let marinate if time allows. 2. Line a sheet pan and spread the marinated chicken in a single layer. Brush with peri peri sauce and lightly spray with avocado oil. Bake in a preheated oven at 200C / 400F for 22-25 minutes until golden and juicy. While it cooks, boil the pasta, drain, and set aside. 3. Remove the chicken and keep all the pan juices. Add chopped onion and bell pepper, toss in the juices, spread flat, and roast at 180C / 370F for 15 minutes until soft and lightly charred. 4. While pan is hot, add extra seasoning, tomato paste, cream cheese, milk, peri peri sauce. Mix gently until melted creamy - the residual heat will help emulsify sauce. If needed, return to oven for 5 minutes. 5. Stir in cooked pasta and parsley until coated. Slice peri peri chicken, serve over pasta, and ENJOY! . . . #periperichicken #healthyrecipes #pasta #mealprep #sheetpandinner

Creamy Chicken in 20 Minutes! Weeknights can get a little hectic, and sometimes you just need something quick and easy for dinner! Pollo alla Valdostana Ingredients 1 lb (450 g) thin chicken cutlets 1/4 lb (115 g) prosciutto cotto (Italian cooked ham) 1/3 lb (150 g) Fontina cheese, shredded 1/2 cup white wine 1/2 cup chicken or vegetable broth (plus an extra 1/2 cup for more sauce) Flour Extra virgin olive oil Knob of butter Salt and pepper Fresh parsley Instructions 1. Heat olive oil and a knob of butter in a pan over medium-high heat. 2. While the butter melts, lightly flour the chicken cutlets and place them directly into the pan. 3. Cook for about 2 minutes per side, seasoning with salt and pepper. 4. Add the white wine and let it reduce for a minute or two. 5. Pour in the broth, then top each cutlet with prosciutto cotto, Fontina cheese, and fresh parsley. 6. Cover and simmer until the chicken is cooked through, the cheese melts, and the sauce thickens. #chicken #easyrecipe #fyp

Marry Me Chicken 🍅✨ A classic dinner idea made a little lighter and packed with protein! This meal is made in one pan and comes together in about 30 minutes. It's the perfect comfort food meal while also helping you hit your protein goals! Makes 4 servings. 4 small chicken breasts (or 2 large cut in half) 1 tbsp olive oil 1 tsp Italian seasoning ½ tsp paprika ½ tsp garlic powder Salt and black pepper, to taste 3 cloves garlic, minced ¾ cup low-sodium chicken broth ⅓ cup chopped sun-dried tomatoes, drained 1 cup low-fat cottage cheese ½ cup fat-free milk ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese 2 cups fresh spinach Fresh basil, for garnish 1. Blend the cottage cheese and fat-free milk until completely smooth and creamy. 2. Season the chicken with the Italian seasoning, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. 3. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook the chicken for 4 minutes per side until golden. Transfer to a plate. 4. Reduce the heat to low-medium and cook the garlic for about 30 seconds until fragrant. 5. Pour in the chicken broth, scraping up any browned bits from the pan. Stir in the sun-dried tomatoes and simmer for 2-3 minutes. 6. Remove the skillet from the heat and let cool for about five minutes. 7. Slowly whisk the cottage cheese mixture into the skillet until smooth. (Make sure tomato mixture is cool enough before adding the cottage cheese to prevent curdling!) 8. Add the spinach and cook until wilted. Add Parmesan and mix until melted. 9. Return the chicken to the skillet and warm over low heat for 3-4 minutes. Garnish with fresh basil and enjoy! Serve over pasta, rice, vegetables or bread. #marrymechicken #easydinnerideas #onepanmeal

✨ Cheesy Meat-Stuffed Breakfast Biscuits ✨ A delicious, flaky, and cheese-packed comfort food recipe featuring golden-brown biscuits stuffed with savory ground meat and melted cheese. 🍴 Ingredients: - 1 package refrigerated biscuit dough or homemade biscuit dough - 1 lb ground beef or sausage, cooked and seasoned - 1.5 cups shredded cheddar cheese - 2 tbsp melted butter - 1 tsp garlic powder - Fresh parsley, finely chopped for garnish - Salt and freshly cracked black pepper to taste 👩🏽‍🍳 Instructions: 1. Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. 2. Cook the ground meat in a skillet with salt, pepper, and garlic powder until fully browned, then drain excess fat. 3. Separate the biscuit dough, flatten each piece slightly, and place a spoonful of cooked meat and a generous amount of shredded cheese in the center. 4. Fold the dough securely around the filling to form stuffed biscuit balls or rounds, pinching the edges to seal. 5. Arrange the stuffed biscuits on the prepared baking sheet. 6. Brush the tops with melted butter and sprinkle a little extra cheese or parsley on top. 7. Bake in the preheated oven for 15 to 18 minutes until the biscuits are golden brown and cooked through. 8. Remove from the oven, let cool slightly, and serve warm. 📝 Notes: These flaky, cheese-stuffed biscuits make the ultimate grab-and-go breakfast, packed with rich flavor in every single bite. #BreakfastBiscuits #StuffedBiscuits #CheeseLovers #ComfortFood #SavoryBaking

High Protein Crockpot Tuscan Chicken    this recipe is so easy to make and packed with protein. save this for your next meal prep 🫶🏽  ingredients:  - 2lb boneless skinless chicken breasts  - 1 yellow onion, chopped)  - 1 bag (~3 oz) sun-dried tomatoes, chopped  - 4 cloves minced garlic  - 1/2 tsp salt - 1/4 tsp pepper - 1/2 tsp oregano  - 1 tbsp olive oil  - 4 cups chicken broth  - 1 1/2 cups dry orzo  - 1/3 cup plain greek yogurt  - 4 cups spinach  - 1/4 cup grated parmesan  directions:  1. spray crockpot with avocado oil  2. add chicken breasts, garlic, onion, sun-dried tomatoes and seasonings 3. cook on high for 3-4 hours (or low for 6-7 hours)  4. shred chicken in the crockpot  5. add dry orzo and greek yogurt and stir to combine  6. cook on high for another 20-30 minutes, until orzo is soft  7. add spinach and parmesan and stir until cheese is melted  8. serve and enjoy!  recipe credit: @brooke | 90 lbs down 🥗 🙂‍↕️ #crockpot #protein #recipesoftiktok #easyrecipe #chicken

💥bang bang chicken 🍗 Ingredients  1.5 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs season to your hearts desire  salt and pepper onion powder  garlic powder  smoked paprika  Sauce 1/2 cup Kewpie mayo @Kewpieusa  3 tbsp sweet chili sauce  Sriracha to taste  1/2 tbsp lime juice  Instructions  1. Pre heat air fryer to 380°F. Clean and trim off excess fat from chicken thighs and pat dry. Place chicken on a baking sheet or mixing bowl, add seasonings to taste. Drizzle with oil and mix to thoroughly combine ensuring all sides are evenly coated. 2. Air fry chicken thighs at 380°F for 12 to 18 minutes, flipping halfway through. Cook until the thickest part of the chicken reaches internal temp of 165°F. 3. While chicken is cooking make the bang bang sauce. Reserve some sauce for topping. Brush remaining sauce to coat top of each chicken thigh. Crank heat up to 400°F or if you have the @From Our Place air fryer like me, switch it to low broil. Cook for an additional 5 minutes until sauce thickens.  4. Serve with rice, garnish with reserved sauce, parsley or chopped green onions and sesame seeds. Enjoy!

‘Tis the season for my most popular recipe ever!!! These rosemary & thyme brown butter Rice Krispies treats are the easy, festive holiday dessert that everyone will love.   Cook time: 20 min plus cooling Serves: 9-16, depending on how you slice ‘em 8 oz (2 sticks) salted butter 4 sprigs thyme, plus more leaves for garnish 2 sprigs rosemary 2 10-oz bags marshmallows, + 2 cups mini marshmallows 4 cups Rice Krispies cereal 4 cups corn flakes cereal 1 cup pecan pieces Flaky salt for garnish In a large, heavy-bottomed pot, melt butter over medium heat. Once melted, add in herbs and continue cooking, stirring constantly, until it begins to foam. Keep stirring until milk solids have caramelized. Remove herbs, add in marshmallows, and stir constantly until melted. Turn off the heat and add in cereals and nuts. Stir to combine. Next, stir in your mini marshmallows. Transfer mixture to a parchment lined 9x9 baking dish. Press into an even layer (I like to use a piece of parchment paper to press down since it’s still hot hot hot). Garnish with more thyme leaves and flaky sea salt. Allow to cool. Cut into squares and serve! Enjoy, enjoy, enjoy. #thanksgivingrecipes #thanksgivingdessert #easydessert #ricekrispiestreats

High Protein Cheesy Honey BBQ Chicken Quesadillas🍗🍯🧀 Easy & Healthy Meal Prep💪🏼 (Macros: Per Quesadilla - 10 Total) 477 Calories 32.7gC | 13gF | 65gP Dont forget to check out my new Aussie Fitness app with more than 350 high protein recipes, meal planning & so much more 👨🏻‍🍳 Ingredients: 1.8KG Boneless & Skinless Chicken Breast (raw weight) BBQ Seasoning: 1 Tbsp Smoked Paprika, 1/2 Tsp Chilli Powder, 1 Tsp Garlic Powder, 1 Tsp Onion Powder, 1 Tsp Salt, 1/2 Tsp Black Pepper (can be substituted for store bought bbq seasoning) 1 Tsp Olive Oil 4 Diced Garlic Cloves 350ml Sugar Free/Reduced Sugar BBQ Sauce (Hughes Sugar Free BBQ Sauce) 100g Honey 20g Diced Chives 1/2 Diced Red Onion (or vegetables of choice) 10 Large Tortillas (Mission Large Carb Balance Tortillas) 500g Light Grated Cheese (Bega 50% Less Fat Grated Cheese) Instructions: 1. Mix smoked paprika, chilli powder, garlic powder, onion powder, salt & black pepper to make the BBQ seasoning. 2. Season chicken with the BBQ seasoning & olive oil. Mix well. 3. Cook chicken in a covered pan over medium heat for around 8 minutes per side until fully cooked. Set aside & shred using 2 forks. 4. In the same pan cook diced garlic in the leftover chicken juices. Add shredded chicken, BBQ sauce, honey, chives & red onion. Mix until well combined. 5. Warm a tortilla then add 25g grated cheese to one half, followed by 1/10 of the chicken filling & another 25g cheese. Fold over. 6. Toast in a pan on both sides until golden & crispy. Repeat for the remaining 9 quesadillas & enjoy! #quesadilla #highprotein #mealprep #healthyrecipes #chicken

VIRAL CARROT WRAPS 🥕 I’ve made a vacation of these with zucchini, pickles, jalapeños, and I had to put a spin on them with carrots. These are probably my second favorite after the zucchini, they come out really good, super pliable/ and they are a touch sweeter which went really well with the toppings I used here. A medium carrot has about 4 net carbs, so this is a great lower carb option if you’re watching carbs. Recipe makes 3-4 wraps Here is how I made it: 1.Preheat oven to 375F.  2.Shred 3 medium carrots into a bowl. Crack in an egg, add 1 cup of shredded pepper jack cheese, toss in 1/2 tbsp smoked paprika, 1/2 tbsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp chipotle pepper (optional), and a small pinch of salt. Mix really well. 3.Grab a cookie sheet, line with parchment paper (important!) and scoop the carrot mixture into circular shapes. You’ll get 3-4 good sized wraps here. 4.Pop it into the oven at 375F for 16-18 minutes. Then remove and let cool for a few minutes while you prep your fillings 5.I spread a base of my homemade guac here. Just mash 2 avocados with the juice of 1 lime, a large handful of freshly chopped cilantro, 1/2 small white onion, a couple pinches of salt, and about a tablespoon of toasted sesame seeds for crunch (optional).  6.I also added some leftover shredded beef (chicken or shrimp work just fine), topped with a tsp of sour cream, some sriracha, and more fresh cilantro. Again, use what you like here! 7.Plate them up and devour. If you make these, be sure to let me know on SHREDHAPPENS - these are a great lowcarb wrap or lower crab bread option, and a great way to sneak in some extra veggies. Tender pan-seared chicken, creamy garlic parmesan gravy, and buttery mashed potatoes that soak up every last drop. ✨ 🕒 Total Time: ~45 minutes 🍽️ Serves: 4-6 📋 Ingredients: • 2 lbs chicken breasts, sliced in half lengthwise • 2 tbsp olive oil • 2 tbsp butter • 2 tbsp all-purpose flour • 1½ cups chicken broth • 1 cup heavy cream or half-and-half • ½ cup grated parmesan cheese • Garlic salt • Onion powder • Paprika • Black pepper • Mashed potatoes, for serving 👩🏼‍🍳 Directions: 1. Season chicken generously with garlic salt, onion powder, paprika, and black pepper. 2. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. 3. Cook chicken 4-5 minutes per side until golden brown and cooked through. Remove from skillet and set aside. 4. Reduce heat to medium. Add butter to the skillet and let melt. 5. Whisk in flour and cook for 1-2 minutes to create a roux. 6. Slowly pour in chicken broth while whisking until smooth and thickened. 7. Stir in heavy cream (or half-and-half) and parmesan cheese. Simmer until the gravy is rich, creamy, and silky smooth. 8. Return the chicken to the skillet and spoon the sauce over top. Simmer for 3-5 minutes. 9. Serve over warm mashed potatoes and drizzle with plenty of that creamy garlic gravy. ✨ This is the kind of dinner that has everyone asking for seconds and a piece of bread to clean the plate. 🤍 #CreamyGarlicChicken #ComfortFood #EasyDinnerRecipe #FamilyDinner

Easy High Protein Honey BBQ Chicken Mac & Cheese🍯🍗🧀 59g Protein Meal Prep💪🏼 (Macros Per Serve, Makes 4 Servings) 587 Calories 67.5gC | 9gF | 59gP Like recipes like this? Check out my cookbooks! LINK IS IN MY BIO 👨🏻‍🍳📚 Ingredients: * 700g Diced Chicken Breast (raw weight) * 1 Tsp Each: Salt, Onion Powder, Smoked Paprika & Garlic Powder * 1 Tsp Olive Oil * 25g Honey * 85g Reduced Sugar or Sugar Free BBQ Sauce (Hughes Sugar Free BBQ Sauce or your preferred BBQ sauce) * 320g Macaroni Pasta (uncooked weight) * 340ml Fat Free Evaporated Milk (Carnation Light & Creamy 99% Fat Free) * 80g Light Cream Cheese * 1.5 Tsp Chicken Stock Powder * 100g Grated Light Cheddar Cheese (Dairyworks Natural Cheddar) Instructions: 1. Add the diced chicken breast to a bowl and season with salt, onion powder, smoked paprika & garlic powder. Drizzle over the olive oil and mix thoroughly until every piece is evenly coated in the seasonings. 2. Heat a pan over medium heat and add the seasoned chicken. Cook for approximately 4 minutes on each side or until golden on the outside and fully cooked through. 3. Reduce the heat to low, then add the honey and BBQ sauce directly to the pan. Toss the chicken through the sauce until every piece is coated in a thick & sticky honey BBQ glaze. Remove from the heat and set aside. 4. Meanwhile bring a pot of salted water to a boil and cook the macaroni according to the packet instructions until al dente. Drain the pasta and set aside. 5. For the cheese sauce add the evaporated milk, light cream cheese and chicken stock powder to a separate pan over medium low heat. Stir until the cream cheese has softened and combined with the milk then gradually add the grated cheddar. Continue stirring until melted into a smooth, rich & creamy cheese sauce. 6. Add the drained macaroni directly into the cheese sauce and mix everything together until the pasta is completely coated in that creamy, cheesy goodness. 7. Divide the honey BBQ chicken and mac & cheese evenly between 4 meal prep containers. Finish with some freshly chopped parsley if desired and enjoy! Meal Prep Pro Tip: Mac & Cheese naturally thickens as it cools because the pasta continues absorbing moisture from the sauce. When reheating add a small splash of milk and give everything a good stir to bring back that smooth, creamy consistency! Store in airtight containers in the fridge for up to 3 to 4 days, or freeze individual portions for longer storage. #macandcheese #mealprep #highprotein #healthyrecipes #chickenmacandcheese

Mix together all of your Cajun seasoning. 2. Season the diced chicken generously with about ⅔ of the seasoning. 3. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and cook for 3–4 minutes until browned on the outside but not completely cooked through. 4. Add the onion and bell pepper and cook for another 2–3 minutes. Add the garlic and cook for about 30 seconds. 5. Add the uncooked pasta, chicken broth and remaining Cajun seasoning. Stir everything together and bring to a gentle boil. 6. Reduce heat to medium-low, cover and cook for 10–13 minutes, stirring every few minutes so the pasta doesn’t stick. 7. Cook until the pasta is al dente and most of the liquid has been absorbed. 8. Reduce the heat to low and stir in the cream cheese and Parmesan until everything comes together into a thick, creamy Cajun sauce. 9. Let it sit for 2–3 minutes to thicken, divide into 6 containers and you’ve got meal prep for the week! Follow for more #mealprep #highprotein #cajunchicken #chickenpasta #fatlossrecipes

Pat the chicken breasts completely dry with paper towels. 2. Season both sides with salt, black pepper, paprika, Italian seasoning, and garlic powder. 3. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. 4. Add the chicken and sear for 5–7 minutes per side until deeply golden and cooked through. 5. Transfer the chicken to a plate and let it rest while preparing the sauce. 6. Reduce the heat to medium and add the butter to the same skillet. 7. Add the heavy cream, Parmesan cheese, red pepper flakes, and dried herbs. 10. Stir continuously until the Parmesan melts and the sauce becomes smooth and creamy. 11. Simmer the sauce for 3–5 minutes until slightly thickened. 12. Return the chicken to the skillet and spoon the creamy sauce generously over the top. 13. Simmer for another 2–3 minutes so the chicken absorbs the sauce. 14. Serve the chicken over warm cooked rice and spoon extra sauce around the plate. 15. Honey Garlic Parmesan Chicken & Potatoes🍗🍯🧀🍟 By far one of the best combos i’ve made, all made around making meal prepping easy and effortless. The chicken is absolutely INCREDIBLE! Macros Per Serving (10 Total) 596 Calories | 54g Protein | 51g Carbs | 19g Fat Ingredients (Makes 10 Servings) Honey Garlic Parmesan Chicken •Marinade - 1500g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs, cubed - 3 Tsp Salt - 3 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 3 Tsp Paprika - 4 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Garlic Granules or Powder - 4 Tsp Italian Herbs - 130g Grated Parmigiano Reggiano - 45g Honey - 8 Tsp / 40g Olive Oil •After Cooking - Extra 15g Honey - Extra 20g Grated Parmesan - Parsley for garnish Crispy Roasted Potatoes - 1800g Raw White/Yellow Potatoes, cubed - 4 Tsp Paprika - 4 Tsp Onion Powder - 4 Tsp Oregano - Olive Oil Cooking Spray, 5 seconds spray Creamy Parmesan Tuscan Sauce •Blender - 700g Fat Free Cottage Cheese - 250g Skimmed Milk - 250g Light Evaporated Milk •Pan - 30g Light Butter - 200g White Onion, finely chopped - 45g Garlic, finely chopped - 200g Sundried Tomatoes, drained & chopped - Handful Fresh Basil Leaves, roughly chopped - 1 Tsp Salt - 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 100g Grated Parmesan - 20g Parmesan Rind Chunks Cooking Instructions 1. Cube chicken thighs. Add seasonings, Parmesan, honey and olive oil. Mix well and set aside. Prepare cream sauce. 2. Cube potatoes and add to a lined sheet pan. Season, spray generously with cooking spray and mix. Spread evenly and bake at 200C / 400F for 35-40 mins until golden and crispy. 3. Meanwhile, melt butter in a large pan over medium heat. Add onion, garlic and sun-dried tomatoes. Cook 10 mins until softened, then add seasonings and fresh basil. 4. Toast 2 mins, then reduce heat to low. Add cream sauce, Parmesan and Parmesan rind. Mix gently until creamy. Do not boil. 5. Remove potatoes. Spread chicken on the same sheet pan and bake at 190C / 380F for 20 mins, then broil/grill 5-6 mins until golden and juicy. Finish with honey and Parmesan. 6. Add crispy potatoes to the cream sauce and gently fold until well coated. Serve and ENJOY! . . #garlicparmesan #healthyrecipes #mealprep #sheetpandinner #batchcooking

Honey Crispy Chicken Ingredients 	•	2 lbs chicken breasts, cubed 	•	2 eggs, beaten 	•	1 ½ cups cornstarch 	•	2 Tbsp soy sauce 	•	½ tsp black pepper 	•	¼ cup brown sugar 	•	¾ cup butter 	•	3–4 cloves garlic, minced 	•	¼ tsp red pepper flakes 	•	¼ cup soy sauce 	•	½ cup honey 	•	1 Tbsp water 	•	1 Tbsp cornstarch (for slurry) 	•	Vegetable oil, for frying 	•	Steamed white rice, for serving ⸻ Instructions 	1.	Prepare the Chicken: 	•	In a bowl, mix chicken cubes with eggs, 2 Tbsp soy sauce, and black pepper. 	•	Add cornstarch and toss until chicken is well coated. 	2.	Fry the Chicken: 	•	Heat vegetable oil in a deep skillet or wok over medium-high heat. 	•	Fry chicken in batches for 5–7 minutes, until golden brown and cooked through. 	•	Remove and drain on paper towels. 	3.	Make the Honey Sauce: 	•	In a saucepan over medium heat, melt the butter. 	•	Add garlic and red pepper flakes, sauté until fragrant. 	•	Stir in brown sugar, ¼ cup soy sauce, and honey. Bring to a gentle boil. 	•	Mix 1 Tbsp water with 1 Tbsp cornstarch in a small bowl to make a slurry. Whisk into the sauce and cook for 2–3 minutes until thickened. 	4.	Combine & Serve: 	•	Add fried chicken to the sauce and toss until coated evenly. 	•	Serve hot over a bed of steamed white rice. #chicken #fyp #fypシ #viral #recipe

This isn't a scene from a film. This is a heartbreaking reality that still exists in parts of Nepal. For some women and girls, getting their period means being sent away from their own home to spend the night in a small shed, away from their families. They are left to face cold nights, fear, loneliness, and the danger of snakes, insects, and wild animals—all because of a natural biological process. Menstruation should never be a reason for exclusion or shame. Take a moment and ask yourself: If it were someone you love—your daughter, your sister, your wife, or your mother—would you accept this as "tradition"? Some customs deserve to be questioned, especially when they put lives and dignity at risk. Every woman deserves to feel safe, respected, and valued, no matter what day of the month it is. Let's raise awareness, start conversations, and stand together to end harmful practices like this. EASY RECIPE BELOW👇😋 𝐂𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐦𝐲 𝐒𝐦𝐨𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐞𝐝 𝐂𝐡𝐢𝐜𝐤𝐞𝐧 & 𝐑𝐢𝐜𝐞  …this one is PURE comfort food & so easy 🥹🍗🍚 the sauce is rich, herby, a little spice, and so good poured over fluffy rice!!🤍✨ ⸻ 𝐈𝐧𝐠𝐫𝐞𝐝𝐢𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐬: 𝐅𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐂𝐡𝐢𝐜𝐤𝐞𝐧: • 2 lbs chicken thighs or breasts • 1 tsp salt • ½ tsp black pepper • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp onion powder • 1 tsp paprika • 1 tsp dried thyme • 1 tsp dried parsley • 2 tbsp olive oil 𝐅𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐒𝐚𝐮𝐜𝐞: • 2 tbsp butter • 1 small onion, diced • 3 cloves garlic, minced • 2 cups chicken broth • 1 cup heavy cream • 1 tsp dried thyme • 1 tsp dried parsley • ½ tsp salt • ½ tsp black pepper • ½ tsp red pepper flakes • 1 tsp cornstarch + 1 tbsp water (optional to make it thicker) 𝐅𝐨𝐫 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐑𝐢𝐜𝐞: • 1½ cups long-grain white rice • 3 cups water or chicken broth ⸻  𝐈𝐧𝐬𝐭𝐫𝐮𝐜𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐬:  1. Season your chicken with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, thyme, and parsley. 2. Heat olive oil in a skillet and sear chicken 4–5 minutes per side until golden. Remove it and set aside with foil over it. 3. In the same pan, add olive oil. Add your diced onion and sauté about 3 minutes until soft. Keep stirring so it doesn’t burn. Then add butter & garlic and cook 30 seconds. 4. Pour in chicken broth to deglaze the pan. Stir in heavy cream, thyme, parsley, salt, pepper, and red pepper flakes. Simmer about 5 minutes. (Add cornstarch slurry if you want it thicker.) 5. Return chicken to the sauce. Cover and simmer on low 10–15 minutes until fully cooked and tender. 6. Cook rice separately… bring liquid to a boil, add rinsed rice, cover and cook about 15 minutes. Let sit 5 minutes, then fluff. 7. Serve chicken over rice and spoon extra creamy sauce on top 🤍 #easydinner #dinnerinspo #easyrecipes #chickenandrice #chickenrecipes

🍔 VIRAL GARLIC PARMESAN CHEESEBURGERS 🧄🧀 Don’t make regular cheeseburgers again until you try them served face down in a pool of creamy garlic Parmesan sauce! 😭🔥 Ingredients For the burgers: * 1 lb ground beef (80/20) * 1 small onion, thinly sliced * Salt, pepper, garlic powder & paprika * 4 slices American cheese * 4 burger buns * Butter for toasting For the garlic Parmesan sauce: * 2 tbsp butter * 4 cloves garlic, minced * 1 cup heavy cream * ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan * ½ tsp garlic powder * ½ tsp smoked paprika * ½ tsp Italian seasoning * Salt & pepper to taste * Fresh parsley Instructions 1. Make the smash burgers: Divide beef into 4 portions. Add sliced onions to a hot skillet, place beef on top and smash into thin patties. Season generously. 2. Get those crispy edges: Sear until browned, flip and cook to 160°F. Top with American cheese and let it melt. 3. Make the sauce: Melt butter in a saucepan, sauté garlic until fragrant, then add heavy cream and seasonings. Simmer gently before stirring in Parmesan until smooth and creamy. 4. Toast your buns: Butter and toast until golden, then assemble your cheeseburgers. 5. Now for the best part! Pour a generous layer of warm garlic Parmesan sauce directly onto your serving plate. Cut each cheeseburger in half and place both halves cut side down directly into the sauce, allowing that cheesy goodness to soak into every bite. 6. Finish it off: Surround the burgers with crispy fries, garnish with parsley and serve immediately! PRO TIP: Keep extra garlic Parmesan sauce on the side because you’re going to want to dip EVERYTHING in it. 😂 #GarlicParmesanBurger #CheeseburgerRecipe #SmashBurgers #ViralRecipes #EasyDinnerIdeas

The chicken dinner that has MILLIONS of views is back! 🤯 And honestly, there’s a reason this recipe has gone so viral! It’s simple, comforting, absolutely delicious, and one of those meals everyone needs in their recipe collection! Not everyone grew up learning how to cook, and that’s exactly why I love sharing easy, home-cooked meals like this! ❤️ My daughter was craving stuffing and cranberry sauce, so we basically had Thanksgiving dinner on a random Tuesday, and nobody was complaining! 😂 Recipe inspired by @allyssainthekitchen! 🍗 VIRAL BAKED CHICKEN THIGHS Ingredients: * Boneless, skinless chicken thighs * Olive oil * Salt & pepper * Garlic powder * Paprika * Italian seasoning * 1 onion, sliced * 2 cups chicken broth * Fresh thyme * Cornstarch + cold water (for gravy) Directions: 1. Preheat oven to 350°F. 2. Place chicken thighs in a baking dish. Drizzle with olive oil, add all seasonings, and toss to coat evenly. 3. Add sliced onion, chicken broth, and fresh thyme. 4. Cover tightly with foil and bake at 350°F for 90 minutes. 5. Remove from oven and increase temperature to 450°F. 6. Remove thyme and carefully pour the cooking liquid into a bowl or measuring cup. Mix cornstarch with cold water to make a slurry, then whisk it into the cooking liquid to make your gravy. 7. Pour the gravy back over the chicken. 8. Return to the oven, uncovered, for another 30 minutes at 450°F, until the gravy has thickened and the chicken is beautifully browned! Serve over mashed potatoes with your favorite sides and ENJOY! If you love easy, family-friendly dinners that taste like you’ve been cooking all day, make sure you’re following along! I’ve got so many more recipes to share! videos.caption: The Journey of Blockem Popem WoodBots ! Two years ago, I shared a video showcasing the first versions of my WoodBots—handmade figures crafted from recycled skateboards, each with a unique mechanical design and gameplay. I was just starting out, developing these creations from scratch. At that time, I only offered WoodBots made from recycled skateboards, but the process took so long because I didn’t have the right tools to streamline production. With the unwavering support of my community, friends, and family—especially my wife, niece, a few close friends, and my dad—I’ve been able to achieve so much since then. Despite the challenges, your patience and encouragement helped me keep pushing forward. One of my proudest moments was securing a patent pending for my WoodBot creations.  However, the journey hasn’t been without setbacks. As the demand for WoodBots grew, I found myself running out of time to finalize the patent. I even had a company step in to help, but it was the last week before the patent expired, and time just wasn’t on my side. After the patent lapsed, they cut contact and left me with no further response. But I’m not giving up. I’ve recently consulted with patent lawyers to explore what it would take to reestablish the patent for WoodBots. It’s a long road, but with your continued support, I believe I can get there. **How You Can Help:** - **Spread the Word:** Share this story and video from two years ago with your friends, family, and on social media. Every share helps bring more eyes to the WoodBots community. - **Support the WoodBot Movement:** Whether through purchasing a WoodBot or engaging with my content, every bit of interaction counts. - **Direct Assistance:** If anyone has experience in patent law or connections that might help me reestablish the patent for WoodBots, I’d be incredibly grateful for any advice or direction. I’m deeply thankful for the journey so far and for everyone who’s been a part of it. Here’s to reestablishing the future of WoodBots and continuing to create something unique together!

Что следующее?/What’s next? #gray #mycolor #pinterest #color #sliver Серый — это нейтральный ахроматический цвет, который образуется при смешении белого и чёрного (или при равной концентрации красного, зелёного и синего в модели RGB). В переносном смысле слово означает бесцветный, будничный, неприметный, а также необразованный или неофициальный. [1, 2, out 3, 4, 5] Подробную информацию о значении и оттенках этого слова можно найти в Викисловаре. [1] Физические и цветовые свойства * Ахроматичность: у цвета нет яркого цветового тона, он находится между белым и чёрным. *  * Оттенки: от светлого серебристого до тёмного графитового и мокрого асфальта. *  * Восприятие: успокаивает нервную систему и служит отличным фоном для других ярких цветов.[1, 2, 3, 4] *  Переносные и разговорные значения     * Тусклый и пасмурный: погода, день или сумерки без солнца. *  * Бесцветный и безликий: скучные будни, рутина или ничем не примечательный человек («серая масса»). *  * Малокультурный: непросвещённый или невежественный человек. *  * Неофициальный («серый» рынок, «серая» зарплата): находящийся в тени закона. [1, 2, 3] *  Цвет — это субъективное зрительное ощущение, которое возникает, когда свет разной длины волны попадает в глаз. Cajun Chicken Alfredo Wraps 🔥 Everything you love about chicken alfredo, but in a crispy toasted wrap… a family favourite that comes together in one pan, all thanks to my go-to stainless steel @Made In Cookware pan If you want cookware that will actually last, check out the full Made In Stainless Collection in my bio… it’s up to 40% off for Black Friday right now! #MadeInPartner For the Chicken: -3 large chicken breasts, flattened -3 tbsp olive oil (divided) -Seasoning: 2 tbsp paprika, 1 tbsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp black pepper, 1–2 tsp cayenne (optional heat) For the Alfredo: -3 tbsp butter -8 garlic cloves, minced -1 1/2 cups heavy cream, room temp -Seasoning: 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder, 1 tsp black pepper, 1/4 tsp salt -1/2 cup mozzarella, shredded (optional) -1 cup fresh parmesan, grated For the Wraps: -Large tortillas -Mozzarella, shredded -Butter, for toasting -Fresh parsley, chopped (optional) Instructions: 1. Pound the chicken to an even thickness. Drizzle with 1 tbsp olive oil & rub in the seasoning until fully coated. 2. Heat the remaining 2 tbsps of olive oil in a large pan over medium-high. Sear the chicken for 5 mins per side until lightly blackened & cooked through. Rest, then slice. 3. Reduce to medium heat. Melt the butter in the same pan (AKA flavor central) & sauté the garlic for 2-3 mins. 4. Pour in the room temp cream (room temp = doesn’t curdle), add the seasonings & mozzarella and simmer until smooth. Stir in the parmesan & simmer 1 more min. 5. On each tortilla, add sauce, mozzarella, chicken, more sauce & parsley. Roll up & toast in melted butter until golden on both sides. 6. Serve with extra alfredo for dipping. Enjoy!! #cookingathometiktoktv #recipesoftiktok #dinner #recipe

🌈 SUPER SIMPLE TASTE-SAFE KINETIC SAND 🌈 If you’re looking for kid safe kinetic sand - this is it! It might not have the silicone binder that store bought has which gives a stretchy effect, but it’s made with 5 simple ingredients, that still gives it the ability to be squished and moulded while holding its shape and it crumbles like sand. It’s fun, cheap, and so easy to whip up… plus your little ones will love it! INGREDIENTS: 1 cup baking soda 1/2 cup sugar 3/4 cup cornflour  1 Tbsp cream of tartar 1/4 cup of water 1 tsp food colouring (optional) HOW TO: 1. Add the baking soda, sugar, cornflour, and cream of tartar to a large bowl, and stir  everything together. 2. In a small cup, mix your food colouring & water (if you’re using food colouring). 3. Add 2 Tbsp of the water into the dry mix and whisk together. If its still too powdery and doesn’t clump in your hands, add 1 Tbsp more of the water, and stir again. Repeat up to the full 1/4 cup of water, squishing with your hands to mix it in and get the right texture (note if you get heavy handed with the water, counterbalance it by adding equal parts cornflour & sugar, 1 Tbsp of each at a time) 4. Enjoy! NOTES: 🫙 Store in an airtight container in the fridge for 4–6 weeks. If it dries out a little, add 1–2 tsp of water and mix it through with your hands. 🌈  you can make the colour brighter by adding a few extra drops into the water at the beginning. 👶 whilst this recipe is taste-safe, make sure to supervise little ones closely as it’s not for eating by the handful.  . . . . . #kineticsand #toddler #kidsactivities #sensoryplay #playtolearn

Quick Recipe: Mix beef, breadcrumbs, egg, milk, and seasonings. Shape into a loaf. Brush with a ketchup, brown sugar, and Worcestershire glaze. Bake at 350°F until the center reaches 160°F. VOLCÁN CHOCOLATE 👇receta escrita👇 CLICK @laura.lopez.mon para más recetas fáciles 💥GUÁRDATE💥 esta receta de pastel de chocolate | lava cake, facilísimo de hacer con 5 ingredientes, sin robots ¡nunca falla! ➖➖➖➖➖➖ 📍 INGREDIENTES 4 unidades 200 g chocolate (mínimo 55% de cacao) 70 g mantequilla 4 huevos M 70 g azúcar 50 g harina trigo común (sin levaduras) Para pincelar los moldes : mantequilla y cacao puro en polvo ➖➖➖➖➖➖ 📍ELABORACIÓN 🔹️ Pon en un recipiente el chocolate y la mantequilla y fúndelo. Deja atemperar 5 minutos 🔹️ Mientras pon en un bol los huevos y el azúcar y bate con unas varillas hasta que espumen. Añade el chocolate y mezcla con una espátula hasta que se integre por completo 🔹️ Añade la harina tamizada y mezcla con la espátula hasta que esté perfectamente integrado 🔹️ Pincela los moldes con mantequilla a punto de pomada y espolvorea con cacao en polvo 🔹️ Llena los moldes con la masa hasta 1 cm del borde. Introduce en el congelador 30 minutos 🔹️ Saca del congelador e introduce en el horno precalentado a 220°C durante 12 minutos ⚠️ la temperatura interior de tu horno puede variar respecto a la mía (cada horno es un mundo) por lo que el tiempo de cocción puede variar entre 12 y 15 minutos. Deberás probar variando los minutos hasta conseguir el punto, pero nunca será menos de 12 ni más de 15 🔹️ Saca del horno y deja reposar 2 minutos. Separa la pared con el fijo de un cuchillo y desmolda 🔹️ Sirve inmediatamente ➖➖➖➖➖➖➖ Feliz día 🤗 #lauralopezmon #lavacake #micuitchocolat #volcandechocolate #coulant

Howlin’ Ray’s Nashville Hot Chicken at Home 🔥 Howlin’ Ray’s at Home Part 1/3 Send this to your mom so she can make it for you ❤️‍🔥 Comeback Sauce + Nashville Hot Chicken & Waffles recipes dropping SOON 😎 Full detailed recipes in bio 🔗 — CONDENSED RECIPE 👇 1️⃣ MARINATE: Pound 2 boneless chicken thighs to ½” thick. Whisk 2 cups buttermilk, ½ cup pickle juice, 2 tbsp hot sauce (@Osmo Kitchen magic sauce), 1 egg, kosher salt, garlic powder, onion powder, mustard powder, paprika, white pepper, cayenne & optional MSG. Add thighs + 6 tenders, cover & refrigerate at least 4 hours, ideally overnight. 2️⃣ COMEBACK SAUCE: Mix mayo, ketchup, hot sauce, Dijon, Worcestershire, lemon juice, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, black pepper & salt. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours. FULL RECIPE DROPPING SOON 🔥 3️⃣ DOUBLE DREDGE: Mix 3 cups flour, 1 cup cornstarch, 1 tbsp baking powder, kosher salt, garlic powder, onion powder, mustard powder, paprika, white pepper, cayenne & optional MSG. Drizzle in 3–4 tbsp chicken marinade and mix to create craggly bits. Dip chicken in marinade → press into flour → rest on a rack for 10 minutes to hydrate flour → repeat marinade + flour before frying. 4️⃣ FRY: Heat neutral oil to 350°F. Fry in batches: tenders about 3–5 minutes; thighs about 5–7 minutes, until golden, CWISPY & 165°F internal. Drain on a clean wire rack. 5️⃣ NASHVILLE HOT OIL: In a heatproof bowl, combine cayenne, paprika, dark brown sugar, garlic powder, onion powder, mustard powder, black pepper, kosher salt & optional MSG. Carefully ladle in 1–1½ cups hot fry oil & whisk for 1-2 minutes to let bloom. Dunk or brush onto chicken. 6️⃣ SERVE: Enjoy with comeback sauce—or pile onto a buttered, toasted brioche bun with slaw, dill pickles & extra sauce. Millionaire shortbread 🤎 Recipe: Shortbread Ingredients 200 g butter 100 g caster sugar 300 g plain flour Caramel: 200g salted butter 3 tbsp caster sugar 4 tbsp golden syrup 397 g condensed milk (one tin) Shortbread: 200 g unsalted butter 100 g caster sugar 300 g plain flour  Caramel: 200 g unsalted butter 3 tbsp caster sugar 4 tbsp golden syrup 397 g condensed milk (one tin) Chocolate layer  250g melted milk chocolate  Method 1. Preheat the oven to 160°C fan and line a 9-inch square tin with baking paper. 2. Rub together the flour, sugar and butter until a crumbly dough forms. 3. Press the mixture firmly into the tin and bake for 20–25 minutes until pale golden. 4. In a saucepan, heat the condensed milk, butter, sugar and golden syrup over medium heat, stirring until the sugar dissolves. 5. Increase the heat and bring to a boil. Cook for 5–7 minutes, stirring constantly, until the caramel thickens and turns golden. 6. Pour the caramel over the shortbread base and refrigerate for 1 hour until set. 7. Melt the milk chocolate and spread evenly over the caramel. Melt the white chocolate, drizzle over the top and swirl using a skewer. 8. Refrigerate for another 1–2 hours until the chocolate has set

This dinner is as easy as 1, 2, 3! 🎉 The formula is simple: a veg + a meat + a sauce. Once you do it this way, you'll never go back! Don't forget to download the @myrecipes app to keep your recipe inspiration organized. 🗂️ Ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds gold potatoes, cut into 1 1/2-inch pieces 1 pound fresh green beans, cut into 2-inch pieces 2 tablespoons olive oil 1 1/2 teaspoons kosher salt, divided 3/4 teaspoon ground black pepper, divided 6 bone-in, skin on chicken thighs 2/3 cup Parmesan garlic sauce, such as Buffalo Wild Wings Directions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (180 degrees C). Toss potatoes and green beans with olive oil, 1 teaspoon salt, and 1/2 teaspoon pepper. Add mixture to a 9x13-inch baking dish and place chicken on top. Sprinkle with remaining salt and pepper. 🧀 Crispy Parmesan Chicken with Garlic Potatoes & Green Beans 🍗🥔 This Crispy Parmesan Chicken with Garlic Potatoes & Green Beans is an easy sheet-pan dinner packed with bold flavor. Juicy oven-roasted chicken is coated in a crispy Parmesan crust, while buttery garlic potatoes and tender green beans roast alongside for a complete, satisfying family meal with minimal cleanup. Ingredients For the Chicken • 4 boneless, skinless chicken breasts • 2 tbsp olive oil • ¾ cup grated Parmesan cheese • ½ cup panko breadcrumbs • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp Italian seasoning • ½ tsp smoked paprika • ¾ tsp salt • ½ tsp black pepper For the Potatoes • 1½ lbs baby Yukon Gold potatoes, halved • 1 tbsp olive oil • 2 tbsp melted butter • 1 tsp garlic powder • ½ tsp paprika • Salt and black pepper, to taste For the Green Beans • 12 oz fresh green beans, trimmed • 1 tbsp olive oil • 2 garlic cloves, minced • 1 tbsp melted butter • Salt and black pepper, to taste For Garnish • 2 tbsp chopped fresh parsley • Lemon wedges Instructions 1. Preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Lightly grease a large sheet pan or line it with parchment paper. 2. Toss the potatoes with olive oil, melted butter, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and pepper. Spread them evenly on one side of the pan and roast for 15 minutes. 3. In a shallow bowl, combine the Parmesan cheese, panko breadcrumbs, garlic powder, Italian seasoning, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper. 4. Brush both sides of the chicken breasts with olive oil, then press them firmly into the Parmesan mixture until well coated. 5. Remove the sheet pan from the oven and move the potatoes to one side. Arrange the coated chicken in the center. 6. Toss the green beans with olive oil, melted butter, minced garlic, salt, and pepper, then place them beside the chicken. 7. Bake for 20–25 minutes, or until the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C) and the potatoes are fork-tender. 8. Switch the oven to broil and cook for 2–3 minutes until the Parmesan crust is extra crispy and golden. 9. Sprinkle with fresh parsley and serve with lemon wedges. Serving Suggestions Serve with Caesar salad, garlic bread, roasted carrots, steamed broccoli, or creamy ranch dipping sauce for a complete restaurant-style dinner. Storage Store leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 4 days. Reheat in the oven or air fryer to keep the chicken crispy. Prep Time: 15 minutes Cook Time: 40 minutes Total Time: 55 minutes Servings: 4 Calories: Approximately 610 per serving #ParmesanChicken #SheetPanDinner #EasyDinner #ComfortFood #FamilyMeals

The cream is easy to recognize because it comes in a round blue metal tin with a white Nivea logo. The cream is white, thick and soft. It has a pleasant, gentle smell. Its main purpose is to moisturize and protect the skin. It helps keep the skin soft, smooth and healthy. It can be used on different parts of the body, such as the face, hands, elbows and legs. Nivea Cream is popular among people of different ages. Both children and adults can use it. It is especially useful when the skin becomes dry because of cold weather or wind. The cream creates a protective layer on the skin and helps keep moisture inside. One of the best things about Nivea Cream is its simple packaging and affordable price. It is easy to find in shops and supermarkets in many countries. People have trusted this product for more than one hundred years. Today, Nivea is a well-known brand that produces many skincare products, including creams, lotions, shampoos and deodorants. Day two of Dolly recipes for Guilty Pleasures Week, and this one is about as easy as dinner gets. Dolly Parton’s 5-Ingredient Chicken Casserole. Save this one because you probably already have most of what you need. Ingredients: 3 cups cooked, shredded chicken 1 (10.5 oz) can cream of chicken soup 1 cup sour cream 1½ cups shredded cheddar cheese 1 sleeve Ritz crackers, crushed Directions: 1. Preheat oven to 350°F and grease a 9-inch square baking dish. 2. Mix the chicken, cream of chicken soup and sour cream. 3. Spread half the chicken mixture in the dish and top with half the cheese. 4. Add the remaining chicken mixture, then the rest of the cheese. 5. Top with the crushed Ritz crackers. 6. Bake for about 30 minutes, until hot and bubbly and the top is golden brown. 7. Let it sit for about 5 minutes before serving. My shortcut: I usually just shred a rotisserie chicken for this. If I have leftover rotisserie chicken in the fridge, even better. It makes this ridiculously easy. Save this one for an easy dinner night, and send it to somebody who loves Dolly. 🤍 #DollyPartonRecipe #ChickenCasserole #EasyDinnerIdeas #5IngredientRecipes #GuiltyPleasuresWeek

Knock Me Naked Cake 🍫 Ingredients: • 1 box Duncan Hines Devil’s Food cake mix • 3 eggs • ½ cup vegetable oil • 1 cup water • 1 can sweetened condensed milk • 1 jar caramel sauce • 1 bag Butterfinger bits • 2 containers Cool Whip Directions: 1. Preheat your oven to 350°F. 2. Prepare your cake mix using 3 eggs, ½ cup of oil and 1 cup of water. 3. Pour into a greased 9x13 baking dish and bake according to the package directions. 4. Once your cake comes out of the oven, poke holes all over the cake. 5. Pour your entire can of sweetened condensed milk over the warm cake. 6. Next, pour half a jar of caramel sauce over the cake, allowing everything to soak into the holes. 7. Sprinkle half of your Butterfinger bits over the cake. 8. Allow your cake to cool completely. 9. Spread your Cool Whip evenly over the top of the cake. 10. Drizzle caramel sauce all over the Cool Whip, then sprinkle the remaining Butterfinger bits on top. 11. Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve. This cake is even better after sitting in the refrigerator overnight! It’s the perfect dessert for church, family gatherings or potlucks! Enjoy! ❤️
